limitations: 590x670x313mm and65kg describe the documented body only. Internal dimensions/strokes,0/π filter positions and external telemetry are explicit engineering geometry, not OEM CAD or GUI.

Standard MCT-V range85000–320000m^-1 uses two separately selected segments85000–200000 and200000–320000m^-1. Six-position wheel has only two standard installed filters; four unused slots are not extra optical ranges.

Resolution50–1600m^-1 is distinct from grid spacing. Additional Gaussian variance broadens documented source resolution; no deconvolution. Unknown source resolution stays unknown, smoothing is a host proxy; finite source edges use nearest continuation only inside smoothing, exported axis never extrapolates.

Real measured VCD for 40 distinct compounds plus 4 essential oils (44 materials), all on a DeltaA scale: 4 cyclic peptides (DataverseNO FBHIJK, CC0), 33 chiral terpenes and 4 essential oils (Zenodo 7875469, CC BY 4.0; 13 terpene files stored as DeltaA x 1e5 are rescaled per the thesis figure axis) and 3 proteins (Zenodo 12666142, CC BY 4.0; block-mean minus D2O, derived). 10 more compounds would be needed for 50. Proteins come from a 23 um cell outside the 25-100 um range and replay only via the explicit Beer-Lambert mode. NIST IR shapes do not supply VCD. No source spectra were measured on this simulated FVS-6000.

No VCD file states its ordinate unit. Peptide A/DeltaA follows PMA50 documentation; terpene/oil A/DeltaA follows article and thesis figure axes that plot these spectra (the only multiplier, 1e-5 for 13 terpene files, is the thesis axis "DeltaA x 10^5", band heights checked); protein units follow the authors' notebook axis labels. Physical replay requires trusted sample accept_inferred_units; original unit evidence and unknown measured temperature remain visible. No invented 298.15 K source temperature.

Measured replay requires the known source solvent, concentration, path and window and source resolution limit; any unknown temperature/path/concentration (terpenes and oils: per-sample concentration and temperature unknown) needs explicit acceptance. The scaled mode multiplies A and DeltaA by (c/c_src)(l/l_src) only when source c and l are documented (peptides, proteins); this Beer-Lambert linearity is an assumption, not a validated concentration- or temperature-dependent FVS response.

Normalized NIST IR only supplies shape. Explicit host amplitude and DeltaA/A constant are synthetic; source gas/solution/solid phase is not reinterpreted as a measured solution response. No inferred molar absorptivity or absolute configuration.

Host blank IR/bias and independent Gaussian white noise are assumptions. Noise_sd_1s/sqrt(frame duration) and duration-weighted frame means model only added noise; fixed noise in measured templates cannot be averaged away. OEM<8e-6 DeltaAbs applies only400m^-1 and1200s; unknown statistic/distribution is not used as a universal noise calibration.

Whole-spectrum integration frames represent already demodulated FTIR/VCD. Apparent transmittance=10^(-(A±DeltaA/2)) of observed blank-corrected means; these are not raw detector photons and may exceed1 for negative apparent absorption. Interferograms, PEM lock-in, polarization imperfections and Fourier reconstruction are unsupported.

Liquid path25–100µm; BaF2 with aqueous samples rejects, CaF2 below110000m^-1 rejects. No solvent optical constants, saturation calibration, absorption heating, precipitation, evaporation or sample consumption is modeled.

TCH option268.15–363.15K uses explicit host C/H and ideal thermal equilibrium, not measured OEM settling. Energy closure applies only this thermal lump. Optical power, PEM dissipation and full instrument energy balance remain not_run.

Three-position stage is an optional finite motion proxy; this configuration loads one center cell and leaves side holders empty. Acquisition requires center position; no automatic three-sample material transfer.

All clocks advance only in step. Cover handling is trusted external scene authority; sample load/unload conserves intact liquid volume and solute. Detector/purge/water readiness is a host declaration, not measured hardware or certified safety.

Completed frame data survive cancellation. Partial blank never becomes a usable background. Completed blank matches grid/resolution/path/filter/solvent/temperature target; its accumulation time may differ explicitly from sample. Power off clears blank.

Current results keep acquisition method/path snapshots. Owned terminal poll keeps complete public spectrum and averaged sample windows across later operations; cancellation of historical terminal operations cannot stop a new one. Data caches/roles are process-local, not restart persistence or operating-system security.

Reference comparison uses only caller-supplied same-grid signed arrays, returns cosine/nonnegative scale/residual with configuration_assignment=not_assigned. No automatic alignment, uncertainty, stereoisomer matching or hidden identity read.
Robot contact, inverse joint authority, OEM drivers, hardware/HIL, factory noise/IRF calibration, real cooling/purge/LN2 behavior and absolute-configuration validation remain not_run.

limitations: 590x670x313mm and65kg describe the documented body only. Internal dimensions/strokes,0/π filter positions and external telemetry are explicit engineering geometry, not OEM CAD or GUI.

Standard MCT-V range85000–320000m^-1 uses two separately selected segments85000–200000 and200000–320000m^-1. Six-position wheel has only two standard installed filters; four unused slots are not extra optical ranges.

Resolution50–1600m^-1 is distinct from grid spacing. Additional Gaussian variance broadens documented source resolution; no deconvolution. Unknown source resolution stays unknown, smoothing is a host proxy; finite source edges use nearest continuation only inside smoothing, exported axis never extrapolates.

Real measured VCD for 40 distinct compounds plus 4 essential oils (44 materials), all on a DeltaA scale: 4 cyclic peptides (DataverseNO FBHIJK, CC0), 33 chiral terpenes and 4 essential oils (Zenodo 7875469, CC BY 4.0; 13 terpene files stored as DeltaA x 1e5 are rescaled per the thesis figure axis) and 3 proteins (Zenodo 12666142, CC BY 4.0; block-mean minus D2O, derived). 10 more compounds would be needed for 50. Proteins come from a 23 um cell outside the 25-100 um range and replay only via the explicit Beer-Lambert mode. NIST IR shapes do not supply VCD. No source spectra were measured on this simulated FVS-6000.

No VCD file states its ordinate unit. Peptide A/DeltaA follows PMA50 documentation; terpene/oil A/DeltaA follows article and thesis figure axes that plot these spectra (the only multiplier, 1e-5 for 13 terpene files, is the thesis axis "DeltaA x 10^5", band heights checked); protein units follow the authors' notebook axis labels. Physical replay requires trusted sample accept_inferred_units; original unit evidence and unknown measured temperature remain visible. No invented 298.15 K source temperature.

Measured replay requires the known source solvent, concentration, path and window and source resolution limit; any unknown temperature/path/concentration (terpenes and oils: per-sample concentration and temperature unknown) needs explicit acceptance. The scaled mode multiplies A and DeltaA by (c/c_src)(l/l_src) only when source c and l are documented (peptides, proteins); this Beer-Lambert linearity is an assumption, not a validated concentration- or temperature-dependent FVS response.

Normalized NIST IR only supplies shape. Explicit host amplitude and DeltaA/A constant are synthetic; source gas/solution/solid phase is not reinterpreted as a measured solution response. No inferred molar absorptivity or absolute configuration.

Host blank IR/bias and independent Gaussian white noise are assumptions. Noise_sd_1s/sqrt(frame duration) and duration-weighted frame means model only added noise; fixed noise in measured templates cannot be averaged away. OEM<8e-6 DeltaAbs applies only400m^-1 and1200s; unknown statistic/distribution is not used as a universal noise calibration.

Whole-spectrum integration frames represent already demodulated FTIR/VCD. Apparent transmittance=10^(-(A±DeltaA/2)) of observed blank-corrected means; these are not raw detector photons and may exceed1 for negative apparent absorption. Interferograms, PEM lock-in, polarization imperfections and Fourier reconstruction are unsupported.

Liquid path25–100µm; BaF2 with aqueous samples rejects, CaF2 below110000m^-1 rejects. No solvent optical constants, saturation calibration, absorption heating, precipitation, evaporation or sample consumption is modeled.

TCH option268.15–363.15K uses explicit host C/H and ideal thermal equilibrium, not measured OEM settling. Energy closure applies only this thermal lump. Optical power, PEM dissipation and full instrument energy balance remain not_run.

Three-position stage is an optional finite motion proxy; this configuration loads one center cell and leaves side holders empty. Acquisition requires center position; no automatic three-sample material transfer.

All clocks advance only in step. Cover handling is trusted external scene authority; sample load/unload conserves intact liquid volume and solute. Detector/purge/water readiness is a host declaration, not measured hardware or certified safety.

Completed frame data survive cancellation. Partial blank never becomes a usable background. Completed blank matches grid/resolution/path/filter/solvent/temperature target; its accumulation time may differ explicitly from sample. Power off clears blank.

Current results keep acquisition method/path snapshots. Owned terminal poll keeps complete public spectrum and averaged sample windows across later operations; cancellation of historical terminal operations cannot stop a new one. Data caches/roles are process-local, not restart persistence or operating-system security.

Reference comparison uses only caller-supplied same-grid signed arrays, returns cosine/nonnegative scale/residual with configuration_assignment=not_assigned. No automatic alignment, uncertainty, stereoisomer matching or hidden identity read.
Robot contact, inverse joint authority, OEM drivers, hardware/HIL, factory noise/IRF calibration, real cooling/purge/LN2 behavior and absolute-configuration validation remain not_run.

limitations: 590x670x313mm and65kg describe the documented body only. Internal dimensions/strokes,0/π filter positions and external telemetry are explicit engineering geometry, not OEM CAD or GUI.

Standard MCT-V range85000–320000m^-1 uses two separately selected segments85000–200000 and200000–320000m^-1. Six-position wheel has only two standard installed filters; four unused slots are not extra optical ranges.

Resolution50–1600m^-1 is distinct from grid spacing. Additional Gaussian variance broadens documented source resolution; no deconvolution. Unknown source resolution stays unknown, smoothing is a host proxy; finite source edges use nearest continuation only inside smoothing, exported axis never extrapolates.

Real measured VCD for 40 distinct compounds plus 4 essential oils (44 materials), all on a DeltaA scale: 4 cyclic peptides (DataverseNO FBHIJK, CC0), 33 chiral terpenes and 4 essential oils (Zenodo 7875469, CC BY 4.0; 13 terpene files stored as DeltaA x 1e5 are rescaled per the thesis figure axis) and 3 proteins (Zenodo 12666142, CC BY 4.0; block-mean minus D2O, derived). 10 more compounds would be needed for 50. Proteins come from a 23 um cell outside the 25-100 um range and replay only via the explicit Beer-Lambert mode. NIST IR shapes do not supply VCD. No source spectra were measured on this simulated FVS-6000.

No VCD file states its ordinate unit. Peptide A/DeltaA follows PMA50 documentation; terpene/oil A/DeltaA follows article and thesis figure axes that plot these spectra (the only multiplier, 1e-5 for 13 terpene files, is the thesis axis "DeltaA x 10^5", band heights checked); protein units follow the authors' notebook axis labels. Physical replay requires trusted sample accept_inferred_units; original unit evidence and unknown measured temperature remain visible. No invented 298.15 K source temperature.

Measured replay requires the known source solvent, concentration, path and window and source resolution limit; any unknown temperature/path/concentration (terpenes and oils: per-sample concentration and temperature unknown) needs explicit acceptance. The scaled mode multiplies A and DeltaA by (c/c_src)(l/l_src) only when source c and l are documented (peptides, proteins); this Beer-Lambert linearity is an assumption, not a validated concentration- or temperature-dependent FVS response.

Normalized NIST IR only supplies shape. Explicit host amplitude and DeltaA/A constant are synthetic; source gas/solution/solid phase is not reinterpreted as a measured solution response. No inferred molar absorptivity or absolute configuration.

Host blank IR/bias and independent Gaussian white noise are assumptions. Noise_sd_1s/sqrt(frame duration) and duration-weighted frame means model only added noise; fixed noise in measured templates cannot be averaged away. OEM<8e-6 DeltaAbs applies only400m^-1 and1200s; unknown statistic/distribution is not used as a universal noise calibration.

Whole-spectrum integration frames represent already demodulated FTIR/VCD. Apparent transmittance=10^(-(A±DeltaA/2)) of observed blank-corrected means; these are not raw detector photons and may exceed1 for negative apparent absorption. Interferograms, PEM lock-in, polarization imperfections and Fourier reconstruction are unsupported.

Liquid path25–100µm; BaF2 with aqueous samples rejects, CaF2 below110000m^-1 rejects. No solvent optical constants, saturation calibration, absorption heating, precipitation, evaporation or sample consumption is modeled.

TCH option268.15–363.15K uses explicit host C/H and ideal thermal equilibrium, not measured OEM settling. Energy closure applies only this thermal lump. Optical power, PEM dissipation and full instrument energy balance remain not_run.

Three-position stage is an optional finite motion proxy; this configuration loads one center cell and leaves side holders empty. Acquisition requires center position; no automatic three-sample material transfer.

All clocks advance only in step. Cover handling is trusted external scene authority; sample load/unload conserves intact liquid volume and solute. Detector/purge/water readiness is a host declaration, not measured hardware or certified safety.

Completed frame data survive cancellation. Partial blank never becomes a usable background. Completed blank matches grid/resolution/path/filter/solvent/temperature target; its accumulation time may differ explicitly from sample. Power off clears blank.

Current results keep acquisition method/path snapshots. Owned terminal poll keeps complete public spectrum and averaged sample windows across later operations; cancellation of historical terminal operations cannot stop a new one. Data caches/roles are process-local, not restart persistence or operating-system security.

Reference comparison uses only caller-supplied same-grid signed arrays, returns cosine/nonnegative scale/residual with configuration_assignment=not_assigned. No automatic alignment, uncertainty, stereoisomer matching or hidden identity read.
Robot contact, inverse joint authority, OEM drivers, hardware/HIL, factory noise/IRF calibration, real cooling/purge/LN2 behavior and absolute-configuration validation remain not_run.

limitations: Documented body2000x700x1000mm and205kg uses the selected Japanese specification;2018 catalog180kg is a recorded source conflict. Internal geometry, prism carrier±0.35rad and cover/shutter strokes are engineering proxies.

Excitation and emission each use double-prism monochromators and a shutter. Two physical shutters share one process state here; no independent OEM timing or optical ray tracing. Ex250–850nm is a conservative engineering bound, not an independently documented calibration range.
Standard detection250–850nm; extended PMT400–1100nm requires trusted installation. Xe150W is nominal lamp electrical power, never sample irradiance or optical flux.

0.025nm wavelength resolution is not spectral bandpass. Explicit Gaussian bandwidths only add variance to documented source bandwidth and cannot recover finer detail. Unknown source width remains unknown; nearest continuation is a smoothing boundary assumption, not exported source extrapolation.
DIT0.1ms–30s is modeled as a rectangular integration gate, not a calibrated hardware response time constant. Scan speed<=10000nm/min; Auto DIT adaptation is unsupported.

Step scans move finite distance, then integrate at fixed wavelength. Continuous scans keep finite velocity and report a trailing DIT window ending at each grid target; non-overlapping gates require DIT<=the shortest spatial interval/scan speed. First continuous point is stationary for one DIT; effective wavelength is the gate midpoint, not an OEM timestamp convention.

Real normalized PL and absorption shapes come from PhotochemCAD; PL is not calibrated watts. Peak amplitude and normalized-absorption excitation factor are explicit assumptions. Negative source baseline points are preserved in queries but clipped only to form nonnegative simulated event rates.

Excitation dependence uses an explicitly accepted Kasha-like absorption-shape proxy, not a measured excitation action spectrum. No absorption/quantum-yield based absolute flux, inner-filter effect, saturation, anti-Stokes emission, reabsorption or radiative-energy closure.

Every PhotochemCAD PL template lacks measured CPL/glum. For kind=synthetic_cpl the host glum defines IL=PL*(1/2+g/4), IR=PL*(1/2-g/4), with|g|<=2. It is not inferred from absorption, ECD, VCD, molecular identity or configuration.

kind=measured_cpl loads one of 57 literature g_lum emitters (signed per enantiomer, solvent/excitation-matched). Camphorquinone replays real source-data PL and g_lum curves; the other 56 are scalar g_lum values valid only inside their reported wavelength/transition windows with host-flat PL amplitude. Values were measured on the cited (mostly non-JASCO) instruments; 39 sign points are derived from explicit mirror/ECD-sign statements and transition-window wavelengths for some Eu/Sm records are typical manifold regions.

Six real CPL/glum reference configurations belong to one WQD/liquid-crystal material system, not six new substances. Raw CPL display mdeg and its radians conversion are not DeltaI; unknown DC/normalization prevents reconstruction of joint PL/IL/IR. References remain query-only and retain source conditions.

Public total PL=IL+IR, CPL=IL−IR, glum=2*CPL/PL. Manufacturer IA denotes approximately half the sum; treating IA as total PL would introduce a factor-of-two error. Source formula layout conflicts are recorded separately.

Independent signal/background/dark equivalent Poisson detector events are a host assumption, not actual analog PMT/lock-in/ADC physics or factory noise calibration. poisson_noise=false returns deterministic expected events. Stray-light<=0.001% is a conditional specification, not used as a universal background or detection floor.

Observed blank is acquired with identical method and solvent. After subtraction a channel or total can be negative; values are preserved and glum is null for low net counts, nonpositive total or negative corrected channels. Ratios are not silently clipped to fabricate physical evidence.

Completed integration gates only contribute detector-event partition and gate-time ledgers; partial cancelled gates have no fabricated final readout. This is not continuous open-shutter exposure, incident/emitted photon conservation or total instrument energy closure.

Complete prefilled-cell volume and solute inventory are conserved through host loading/unloading. Concentration is inventory only; unknown source concentration/temperature remain null and require explicit acknowledgment. No chemical products, bleaching or sample consumption.

Pure reads/exports never sample noise or advance time. Results and owned terminal polls retain complete spectra, original method and sample windows across later runs; cancellation of old terminal operations never stops a new one. Permissions/cache are process-local, not restart persistence or OS security.

External manual cover/sample authority, ideal shutter logic and lamp warmup are not certified hardware safety. Real PMT gain/polarization calibration, OEM noise/covariance, Auto DIT, external DC analog measurements, robot contact, hardware/HIL and absolute-configuration assignment remain not_run.

limitations: Documented vario EL cube body480x550x570mm; body mass unknown. Standard80-position open carousel; optional60/120 positions unsupported. Front door and detachable maintenance furnace carriage are engineering scene proxies, not a robot maintenance mechanism.

CHNS/CHN/CNS/CN supported. Current organic20mg, inorganic1.5g and absoluteC40mg/H3mg/N15mg/S6mg limits enforced; for unreported elements the entire unreported remainder is a conservative capacity upper bound, not an actual element estimate.

Furnace target max1473.15K(1200C). Tin capsule local flash1800C is not a furnace setpoint. Two first-order furnace lumps, accelerated example heat capacity/conductance, finite carousel/ball-valve speed and oxygen pulse are host assumptions, not OEM timing or thermal calibration. Model reaction requires combustion target>=873.15K and reduction target>=673.15K as explicit conservative engineering cutoffs, not manufacturer limits; no Arrhenius temperature dependence or full conversion guarantee.

Reported source mass fractions are real Found/manufacturer observations. Molecular formulas/calculated composition never populate measured fractions. Source basis and unknown source conditions remain explicit. Measured references are not certified reference materials; manufacturer unspecified +/- values are not standard deviations.

CHN with missing S returns S=null; trackedS=0 means no reported/assumed S inventory, never actual zero S. All unreported remainder retains unknown identity and phase, never oxygen, purity or ash inferred by subtraction.

Finite lumped conversion dM/dt=-kM limited by explicitly external reagent O2. Nominal tracked C/H/S need respectively1,1/4,1 molO2 per atom mol to formCO2/H2O/SO2; N maps nominally toN2. Unknown sample oxygen and remainder chemistry are not inferred. No whole-gas mass reconstruction or oxide chemistry is claimed.

Reduction is an explicitly assumed ideal gas conversion/transport delay, not copper capacity, NOx reaction kinetics or oxygen-removal cartridge chemistry. Heated lines/carrier readiness are host conditions; actual condensation, flow, leak detection and gas safety are not modeled.

APT orderN2->CO2->H2O->SO2, omitted channels removed from sequence. N2 uses direct transport buffer, not an adsorption column. Three adsorbent-specific gas buffers use host exponential releases. Each next gate waits for observed prior TCD signal to remain within the baseline threshold; no fixed overlapping Gaussian GC peaks.

Finite tail inventory continues to decay to the observed detector and exhaust, including contamination below the chosen baseline criterion. Residual unconverted elements and unreported remainder are retained in explicit residue accounts. Mode-excluded tracked products have a separate unselected-exhaust account.

Equivalent TCD relative signal is baseline + sum(gain_s_per_kg * released_mass/detector_window_s) + host Gaussian per-window noise. It is not calibrated volts or a measured chromatogram. Noise is independent of source precision claim<0.1percentage point (fraction0.001). Full noise/time-step/physical-parameter convergence is not established.

Complete blank captures observed pre-injection baseline at matched method and furnace targets; sample areas integrate signal minus that observed baseline, avoiding wrong subtraction of fixed areas across different gate durations. Background drift, detector nonlinearity and unknown carrier cross-sensitivity are not modeled.

Calibration uses at least3 caller-supplied standard areas with real reported reference fractions, stable affine fit versus absolute element mass, positive finite slope, matching method/furnace/basis and bounded interpolation. No sample-identity look-up in analysis; uncalibrated, extrapolated, nonphysical or unselected fractions are null, not clipped.

limitations: Selected standaloneCSH has native LCD/keypad, documented340x660x480mm and approximately35kg. Hinged front door and removable top cover with host-supported0.15m vertical maintenance lift, syringe60mm working stroke mapped to2mL and8-port angles are engineering geometry; total syringe nominal capacity/travel unverified. External autosampler/POC/TN options unsupported.

TC0–30kgC/m3 andIC0–35kgC/m3 source ranges;4microgram/L=4e-6kgC/m3 is conditional documented LOD, not Gaussian sigma or a nonzero lower range bound. CV1.5%max or±4microgram/L and dilution±2/5% are not simulated noise distributions.

Documented10–2000microlitre injections. Dilution1 means none;2–50 means explicitly modeled carbon-free dilution. Each aliquot withdraws injection_volume/dilution from the original bottle and consumes exact diluent volume; acid is separately added. Pure acid/diluent and homogeneous mixing are explicit assumptions.

680C=953.15K catalytic conversion; furnace finite first-order thermal parameters and accelerated examples are host assumptions.600VA is not furnace power. Net C*dT heat balance is not electrical/chemical/vapour energy closure.

Sample truth usesIC/nonpurgeableOC/purgeableOC origin warehouses. Missing IC or organic partition requires trusted explicit assumptions; TOC is not silently NPOC and DOC is not accepted as total-water TOC. Public source records preserve unknown channels and conditions.

TC converts an independent original aliquot; IC acidifies and sweeps a different unburned original aliquot with no organic oxidation. TOC is mean of paired observedTC-IC values. NPOC acidifies/sparges before remaining carbon is catalytically oxidized; purgeableOC and IC go to explicit purge accounts, not TOC measurements.

Acid release uses a conservative2mol proton/molIC-carbon carbonate-equivalent budget and host first-order coefficient; actual bicarbonate/carbonate/alkalinity/pH not reconstructed. Acid ledger tracks delivered reagent amount. Original source water speciation remains unknown.

Organic oxidation uses host carbon conversion coefficient and explicitly supplied molO2/molOC coefficient. Oxygen-limited residual carbon is retained. Unknown molecular oxygen/hydrogen stoichiometry is not inferred; no full CO2/water product mass or species-resolved mineralization claim.

Preparation vessel, acidification, IC transport and catalytic aliquot routes are lumped functional buffers, not fully resolved OEM8-port pneumatic plumbing. Partial acid removal or sparging can bias NPOC; slow stripping/reaction are not forcibly completed to match source values.

NDIR is relative baseline+gain_s_kg*released_carbon/window+host Gaussian event noise. Peak gas/tails release exponentially; observed baseline threshold controls completion. Earlier finite tails can contaminate later gates, and undetected remaining carbon is retained; this is synthetic observed response, not manufacturer raw trace/volts.

Matching response conditions exclude mode/injection/dilution/repeats because calibration uses absolute carbon mass, but retain treatment and peak-window settings. Matrix drift/nonlinearity/cross-sensitivity are unmodeled.

At least3 actual supplied standard areas fit a stable affine curve versus known source carbon concentration*injection/dilution. Cross-source-quantity transfer requires explicit acknowledgment and stays flagged. Historical certified assigned values are documentary references, not new individual measurements or currently valid physical CRM lots.

Only interpolation within calibrated absolute carbon-mass range yields concentration. No unknown-sample identity lookup in inference. Original settings and selected complete curves freeze with each aliquot; unavailable/out-of-range values remain null. Source-reference composition and observed synthetic response are distinct.

PairedTOC differences remain signed; negative differences yield explicitQC without clipping. All replicates remain present; sampleSD(ddof1) is null for one observation andCV is null for nonpositive means. No silent outlier deletion or CPH LabSolutions ER/ES/QC claim.

Instance memory stores2000 complete results including all replicate peaks and60 complete calibration curves; capacity-full and duplicate curve IDs reject before mutation. Results may be explicitly removed; no automatic eviction. This is process-local storage, not USB writing, reboot persistence or OEM data format.

Cancellation retains already withdrawn liquid, carbon and partial peaks; power-off trusted drain moves residual liquid to waste and residual gas to tail. It does not return consumed aliquots to the bottle. Hot self-sustaining chemistry, evaporation and real emergency shutdown are not modeled.

Pure queries do not advance clock or draw noise. Historical terminal polls preserve complete method/calibration/peaks under owner ACL, even after result-store removal or later methods. Access controls are process-local, not protection against host OS/file access.

Full quantitative range, certified repeatability/LOD, actual NDIR response, pH/speciation, variable matrix recovery, full parameter/noise convergence, real hardware/robot contact, USB/reboot storage and optional POC/TN/autosampler remain not_run.

Documented10–2000microlitre injections. Dilution1 means none;2–50 means explicitly modeled carbon-free dilution. limitations: contrAA800D includes flame and graphite furnace with motorized swivel changeover and AS-GF liquid sampler. SolidAA/hydride hardware optional and absent; emission mode documented but unsupported here. No built-in LCD: six readouts are a simulation-only external overlay, not ASpectCS GUI.

Manufacturer body780x775x625mm and170kg, AS-GF250x380x550mm and7.2kg separate. Combined177.2kg is derived assembly mass, not the body mass. Component mass/inertia and joint speeds remain engineering proxies.

185–900nm coverage;0.002nm resolution documented at200nm only,0.4pm wavelength reproducibility not Gaussian sigma. Host Gaussian line width and event noise are assumed independently; no uniform OEMresolution/precision claim across all wavelengths.

Real atomic line wavelengths retain source air/vacuum medium; no silent medium conversion. Chosen line/element checked.21-point local synthetic detector spectrum is not the200-pixel OEMCCD readout; simultaneous linear-reference background is an explicit simplified surrogate, not OEMIBC/LSBC.

Only documented measured/prepared liquid elemental concentrations drive physical samples. Concentration0–1000kg/m3 is an explicit numerical liquid-model domain, not an OEM analytical range. Solid mass fractions without documented digestion mass/volume cannot become solution concentrations. Censored/line-only records remain query references. Atomic lines from60elements do not mean60 measured sample concentrations.

limitations: contrAA800D includes flame and graphite furnace with motorized swivel changeover and AS-GF liquid sampler. SolidAA/hydride hardware optional and absent; emission mode documented but unsupported here. No built-in LCD: six readouts are a simulation-only external overlay, not ASpectCS GUI.

Manufacturer body780x775x625mm and170kg, AS-GF250x380x550mm and7.2kg separate. Combined177.2kg is derived assembly mass, not the body mass. Component mass/inertia and joint speeds remain engineering proxies.

185–900nm coverage;0.002nm resolution documented at200nm only,0.4pm wavelength reproducibility not Gaussian sigma. Host Gaussian line width and event noise are assumed independently; no uniform OEMresolution/precision claim across all wavelengths.

Real atomic line wavelengths retain source air/vacuum medium; no silent medium conversion. Chosen line/element checked.21-point local synthetic detector spectrum is not the200-pixel OEMCCD readout; simultaneous linear-reference background is an explicit simplified surrogate, not OEMIBC/LSBC.

Only documented measured/prepared liquid elemental concentrations drive physical samples. Concentration0–1000kg/m3 is an explicit numerical liquid-model domain, not an OEM analytical range. Solid mass fractions without documented digestion mass/volume cannot become solution concentrations. Censored/line-only records remain query references. Atomic lines from60elements do not mean60 measured sample concentrations.

crm_* liquid records come from the shared CRM element library: NIST1640a/1643f certificate-printed mass concentrations, NIST3100-series certified mass fractions as a declared gravimetric working standard (0.1g to100mL, c=w*m/V) and NIST/USGS solid CRM values as a declared total digest (0.25g to50mL, complete recovery assumed). Preparations are declared library inputs, not performed or measured; certificate values are not contrAA measurements and AAS responses stay synthetic. Ru/Ir lines have no CRM concentration.

Selected-element mass moves through sample, pipette, graphite tube, beam, deposit, waste/exhaust and removed warehouses. Unmeasured matrix and full chemical products are not inferred. Flame aerosol fraction/atomization and graphite pyrolysis loss and release are host coefficients, not measured recovery.

Flame uses air/acetylene engineering flow/inventory and finite ignition. Graphite program dry/pyrolysis/atomize/clean is ramp limited to3000K/s and3273.15K; standard tube50uL, PIN40uL alternative not installed. AS-GF minimum1uL and108positions documented; actual cannula stroke/arm geometry approximated.

Graphite acquisition samples hold atomization and flush windows; baseline and prior stages retained. Full sample drying/ashing chemistry, matrix modifiers, adsorption memory and radiative heat exchange unvalidated. Net furnace C*dT is not total electrical/chemical energy.

Observed normalized transmission is converted to apparent absorbance with finite floor/saturation and host event noise. Linear background uses two simultaneous side pixels. Integrated corrected absorbance is calibrated by >=3 supplied standard observations with real liquid reference concentrations. Samples never return source concentration directly.

Calibration is specific to element,line,mode,volume,background, burner position and furnace program. Burner height/rotation affect geometry and invalidate response calibration; no unmeasured flame-height response or angular path correction is invented. Only interpolation yields concentrations; saturated or outside-range results stay null. Negative noise integrals and all replicates retained; no zero clipping or silent outlier deletion.

Selected-element ledger is fixed to the first nonblank sample element per instance; create another instance for another element. Fast-sequential multi-element queue is not implemented. Only current sample vessel is host-loaded; AS-GF positions are explicit geometry. Full multi-vial scheduling, automatic dilution/spikes/modifiers/preconcentration and OEMGUI menus unsupported. User dilution is an externally prepared sample assumption, not performed by this model.

Cancellation retains partial peaks, withdrawn liquid and element residues; cold external clean transfers residues to waste rather than returning them to the donor. Fuel/oxidant/argon inventory use is not full stoichiometry; actual pressure basis, seals, flame geometry and emergency flushing unmodeled.

Queries do not advance clock or RNG. Historical operation result snapshots are owner protected and retained after record removal/method changes. Process-local256result/32curve capacities are engineering bounds, not manufacturer storage promises. No reboot persistence or OS/filesystem truth isolation.

Factory sensitivity anchors Cu324nm flame100mm burner andPb283nm graphite20uL are limited documented benchmarks, not generalized gains. Full noise/parameter convergence, detection limits, matrix recovery, actual calibration, fault probabilities, OEMhardware/HIL and robot reverse contact remain not_run.

limitations: contrAA800D includes flame and graphite furnace with motorized swivel changeover and AS-GF liquid sampler. SolidAA/hydride hardware optional and absent; emission mode documented but unsupported here. No built-in LCD: six readouts are a simulation-only external overlay, not ASpectCS GUI.

Manufacturer body780x775x625mm and170kg, AS-GF250x380x550mm and7.2kg separate. Combined177.2kg is derived assembly mass, not the body mass. Component mass/inertia and joint speeds remain engineering proxies.

185–900nm coverage;0.002nm resolution documented at200nm only,0.4pm wavelength reproducibility not Gaussian sigma. Host Gaussian line width and event noise are assumed independently; no uniform OEMresolution/precision claim across all wavelengths.

Real atomic line wavelengths retain source air/vacuum medium; no silent medium conversion. Chosen line/element checked.21-point local synthetic detector spectrum is not the200-pixel OEMCCD readout; simultaneous linear-reference background is an explicit simplified surrogate, not OEMIBC/LSBC.

Only documented measured/prepared liquid elemental concentrations drive physical samples. Concentration0–1000kg/m3 is an explicit numerical liquid-model domain, not an OEM analytical range. Solid mass fractions without documented digestion mass/volume cannot become solution concentrations. Censored/line-only records remain query references. Atomic lines from60elements do not mean60 measured sample concentrations.

crm_* liquid records come from the shared CRM element library: NIST1640a/1643f certificate-printed mass concentrations, NIST3100-series certified mass fractions as a declared gravimetric working standard (0.1g to100mL, c=w*m/V) and NIST/USGS solid CRM values as a declared total digest (0.25g to50mL, complete recovery assumed). Preparations are declared library inputs, not performed or measured; certificate values are not contrAA measurements and AAS responses stay synthetic. Ru/Ir lines have no CRM concentration.

Selected-element mass moves through sample, pipette, graphite tube, beam, deposit, waste/exhaust and removed warehouses. Unmeasured matrix and full chemical products are not inferred. Flame aerosol fraction/atomization and graphite pyrolysis loss and release are host coefficients, not measured recovery.

Flame uses air/acetylene engineering flow/inventory and finite ignition. Graphite program dry/pyrolysis/atomize/clean is ramp limited to3000K/s and3273.15K; standard tube50uL, PIN40uL alternative not installed. AS-GF minimum1uL and108positions documented; actual cannula stroke/arm geometry approximated.

Graphite acquisition samples hold atomization and flush windows; baseline and prior stages retained. Full sample drying/ashing chemistry, matrix modifiers, adsorption memory and radiative heat exchange unvalidated. Net furnace C*dT is not total electrical/chemical energy.

Observed normalized transmission is converted to apparent absorbance with finite floor/saturation and host event noise. Linear background uses two simultaneous side pixels. Integrated corrected absorbance is calibrated by >=3 supplied standard observations with real liquid reference concentrations. Samples never return source concentration directly.

Calibration is specific to element,line,mode,volume,background, burner position and furnace program. Burner height/rotation affect geometry and invalidate response calibration; no unmeasured flame-height response or angular path correction is invented. Only interpolation yields concentrations; saturated or outside-range results stay null. Negative noise integrals and all replicates retained; no zero clipping or silent outlier deletion.

Selected-element ledger is fixed to the first nonblank sample element per instance; create another instance for another element. Fast-sequential multi-element queue is not implemented. Only current sample vessel is host-loaded; AS-GF positions are explicit geometry. Full multi-vial scheduling, automatic dilution/spikes/modifiers/preconcentration and OEMGUI menus unsupported. User dilution is an externally prepared sample assumption, not performed by this model.

Cancellation retains partial peaks, withdrawn liquid and element residues; cold external clean transfers residues to waste rather than returning them to the donor. Fuel/oxidant/argon inventory use is not full stoichiometry; actual pressure basis, seals, flame geometry and emergency flushing unmodeled.

Queries do not advance clock or RNG. Historical operation result snapshots are owner protected and retained after record removal/method changes. Process-local256result/32curve capacities are engineering bounds, not manufacturer storage promises. No reboot persistence or OS/filesystem truth isolation.

Factory sensitivity anchors Cu324nm flame100mm burner andPb283nm graphite20uL are limited documented benchmarks, not generalized gains. Full noise/parameter convergence, detection limits, matrix recovery, actual calibration, fault probabilities, OEMhardware/HIL and robot reverse contact remain not_run.

limitations: Chosen configuration is ICPE-9820 simultaneous axial/radial ICP-OES; ICPE-9810 is axial only. Standard natural aspiration and gravity drainage. AS-10/ASX autosamplers, peristaltic pump and online internal-standard addition are optional and absent. No original instrument LCD: six engineering readouts are a simulation-only external panel.

167–800nm coverage; <=0.005nm resolution is documented at200nm only. 27MHz RF maximum1600W;6kVA main-unit supply is not RF power or total heat. Host Gaussian sigma, detector noise, view factor and concentration gain are independent assumptions, not OEM calibrations or NIST Aki-derived response.

Normal11.7L/min and Eco5.5L/min are reported total-Ar reference consumptions without a manufacturer temperature/pressure basis. The host explicitly supplies absolute reference T/P for ideal molar accounting. Eco is standby only,500W; brochure approximately5L/min plasma gas is not5.5L/min total consumption. Other brochure12.333L/min normal consumption and10min/30min startup references remain source conflicts, not calibrated runtime defaults.

Finite mirror position selects view while the vertical torch remains fixed. Door angle, mirror displacement, isolation-valve stroke and rates are engineering proxies. Vacuum is an ideal pumped chamber with finite isolation valve and no modeled leak/backflow, not whole-optics argon purge. Ideal lumped plasma thermal state is not a measured electron temperature.

Opening the plasma door or losing modeled Ar extinguishes plasma and cancels measurement while retaining transferred matter and completed windows. Host coolant range/flow and exhaust are startup conditions; live coolant stoppage and the actual OEM control electronics are not modeled. At least180s after extinction plus an assumed cold-temperature threshold is an explicit host maintenance policy based on touch-safety advice, not a demonstrated OEM electronic timer lock.

True source concentrations drive multi-element liquid inputs. Unreported, censored, saturated-source and Si/SiO2-basis-ambiguous entries remain unknown; source-only atomic references cannot be loaded as concentration samples. At most128 tracked declared elements and0–100kg/m3 per-element numeric domain are engineering limits, not OEM quantitation ranges. Matrix and missing elemental species are not inferred.

All68 eligible NIST observed I/II lines are modeled concurrently irrespective of selected quantitative lines. OEM source-only lines do not create duplicate peaks. Source air/vacuum wavelength coordinates are retained without conversion; the synthetic grid is not a unified metrological vacuum axis. Aki and wavelength uncertainty are references, not signal gain or line-spread sigma.

Saved spectrum uses1024 coarse background points plus25 dense points per eligible line on a unique nonuniform167–800nm grid. It is a synthetic spectral surrogate, not the million-pixel cooled CCD or a measured whole spectrum. Contributions of unreported elements, other transitions, line self-absorption and radiative transfer are unmodeled; element_response_available=false never establishes chemical absence.

Natural uptake withdraws finite solution into aerosol and plasma compartments with exact first-order transfer; rejected aerosol and incomplete atomization go to waste. Each declared element balances registered=donor+aerosol+plasma+waste+exhaust+removed. Carrier solution evaporation is liquid-equivalent volume, not water gas volume or full plasma reaction stoichiometry. Ar and ideal vacuum gas each balance initial=remaining+consumed.

Each complete detector window shares full spectral values and simultaneous reference-flank background. Integrals use actual window lengths; matched observed blank and >=3 observed multi-element standards determine per-line response. Only calibration interpolation returns concentrations; clipping/out-of-range remain null. Source concentrations are not copied to output and no original source CCD/noise is reconstructed.

Response signatures bind view, RF, gas flow, stabilization/integration/flush windows and background. Selected line subset and repeat count may change without invalidating already observed full-line blank/covering curve. Dilution is explicit external host preparation, not an installed automatic diluter. All repeats retained; no hidden outlier deletion or negative-area clipping.

Historical asynchronous results are owner protected and immutable after later acquisitions/method changes or record deletion. Queries do not consume time or random numbers. Storage256results/32curves and20000trace-points are engineering bounds; no reboot persistence or OS-level isolation claim.

Published application options (autosampler, pump and online Y internal standard), exact original line/matrix/RF/view protocols, full OEM interference correction, certified response/noise/LOD/precision convergence, real hardware/HIL and reverse robot contact remain not_run. The current standard aqueous model does not install organic-solvent special Ar/O2 hardware.

AS-10/ASX autosamplers, peristaltic pump and online internal-standard addition are optional and absent. No original instrument LCD: six engineering readouts are a simulation-only external panel.

167–800nm coverage; <=0.005nm resolution is documented at200nm only. 27MHz RF maximum1600W;6kVA main-unit supply is not RF power or total heat. Host Gaussian sigma, detector noise, view factor and concentration gain are independent assumptions, not OEM calibrations or NIST Aki-derived response.

Normal11.7L/min and Eco5.5L/min are reported total-Ar reference consumptions without a manufacturer temperature/pressure basis. The host explicitly supplies absolute reference T/P for ideal molar accounting. Eco is standby only,500W; brochure approximately5L/min plasma gas is not5.5L/min total consumption. Other brochure12.333L/min normal consumption and10min/30min startup references remain source conflicts, not calibrated runtime defaults.

Finite mirror position selects view while the vertical torch remains fixed. Door angle, mirror displacement, isolation-valve stroke and rates are engineering proxies. Vacuum is an ideal pumped chamber with finite isolation valve and no modeled leak/backflow, not whole-optics argon purge. Ideal lumped plasma thermal state is not a measured electron temperature.

Opening the plasma door or losing modeled Ar extinguishes plasma and cancels measurement while retaining transferred matter and completed windows. Host coolant range/flow and exhaust are startup conditions; live coolant stoppage and the actual OEM control electronics are not modeled. At least180s after extinction plus an assumed cold-temperature threshold is an explicit host maintenance policy based on touch-safety advice, not a demonstrated OEM electronic timer lock.

True source concentrations drive multi-element liquid inputs. Unreported, censored, saturated-source and Si/SiO2-basis-ambiguous entries remain unknown; source-only atomic references cannot be loaded as concentration samples. At most128 tracked declared elements and0–100kg/m3 per-element numeric domain are engineering limits, not OEM quantitation ranges. Matrix and missing elemental species are not inferred.

All68 eligible NIST observed I/II lines are modeled concurrently irrespective of selected quantitative lines. OEM source-only lines do not create duplicate peaks. Source air/vacuum wavelength coordinates are retained without conversion; the synthetic grid is not a unified metrological vacuum axis. Aki and wavelength uncertainty are references, not signal gain or line-spread sigma.

Saved spectrum uses1024 coarse background points plus25 dense points per eligible line on a unique nonuniform167–800nm grid. It is a synthetic spectral surrogate, not the million-pixel cooled CCD or a measured whole spectrum. Contributions of unreported elements, other transitions, line self-absorption and radiative transfer are unmodeled; element_response_available=false never establishes chemical absence.

Natural uptake withdraws finite solution into aerosol and plasma compartments with exact first-order transfer; rejected aerosol and incomplete atomization go to waste. Each declared element balances registered=donor+aerosol+plasma+waste+exhaust+removed. Carrier solution evaporation is liquid-equivalent volume, not water gas volume or full plasma reaction stoichiometry. Ar and ideal vacuum gas each balance initial=remaining+consumed.

Each complete detector window shares full spectral values and simultaneous reference-flank background. Integrals use actual window lengths; matched observed blank and >=3 observed multi-element standards determine per-line response. Only calibration interpolation returns concentrations; clipping/out-of-range remain null. Source concentrations are not copied to output and no original source CCD/noise is reconstructed.

Response signatures bind view, RF, gas flow, stabilization/integration/flush windows and background. Selected line subset and repeat count may change without invalidating already observed full-line blank/covering curve. Dilution is explicit external host preparation, not an installed automatic diluter. All repeats retained; no hidden outlier deletion or negative-area clipping.

Historical asynchronous results are owner protected and immutable after later acquisitions/method changes or record deletion. Queries do not consume time or random numbers. Storage256results/32curves and20000trace-points are engineering bounds; no reboot persistence or OS-level isolation claim.

Published application options (autosampler, pump and online Y internal standard), exact original line/matrix/RF/view protocols, full OEM interference correction, certified response/noise/LOD/precision convergence, real hardware/HIL and reverse robot contact remain not_run. The current standard aqueous model does not install organic-solvent special Ar/O2 hardware.

limitations: Chosen configuration is ICPE-9820 simultaneous axial/radial ICP-OES; ICPE-9810 is axial only. Standard natural aspiration and gravity drainage. AS-10/ASX autosamplers, peristaltic pump and online internal-standard addition are optional and absent. No original instrument LCD: six engineering readouts are a simulation-only external panel.

167–800nm coverage; <=0.005nm resolution is documented at200nm only. 27MHz RF maximum1600W;6kVA main-unit supply is not RF power or total heat. Host Gaussian sigma, detector noise, view factor and concentration gain are independent assumptions, not OEM calibrations or NIST Aki-derived response.

Normal11.7L/min and Eco5.5L/min are reported total-Ar reference consumptions without a manufacturer temperature/pressure basis. The host explicitly supplies absolute reference T/P for ideal molar accounting. Eco is standby only,500W; brochure approximately5L/min plasma gas is not5.5L/min total consumption. Other brochure12.333L/min normal consumption and10min/30min startup references remain source conflicts, not calibrated runtime defaults.

Finite mirror position selects view while the vertical torch remains fixed. Door angle, mirror displacement, isolation-valve stroke and rates are engineering proxies. Vacuum is an ideal pumped chamber with finite isolation valve and no modeled leak/backflow, not whole-optics argon purge. Ideal lumped plasma thermal state is not a measured electron temperature.

Opening the plasma door or losing modeled Ar extinguishes plasma and cancels measurement while retaining transferred matter and completed windows. Host coolant range/flow and exhaust are startup conditions; live coolant stoppage and the actual OEM control electronics are not modeled. At least180s after extinction plus an assumed cold-temperature threshold is an explicit host maintenance policy based on touch-safety advice, not a demonstrated OEM electronic timer lock.

True source concentrations drive multi-element liquid inputs. Unreported, censored, saturated-source and Si/SiO2-basis-ambiguous entries remain unknown; source-only atomic references cannot be loaded as concentration samples. At most128 tracked declared elements and0–100kg/m3 per-element numeric domain are engineering limits, not OEM quantitation ranges. Matrix and missing elemental species are not inferred.

All68 eligible NIST observed I/II lines are modeled concurrently irrespective of selected quantitative lines. OEM source-only lines do not create duplicate peaks. Source air/vacuum wavelength coordinates are retained without conversion; the synthetic grid is not a unified metrological vacuum axis. Aki and wavelength uncertainty are references, not signal gain or line-spread sigma.

Saved spectrum uses1024 coarse background points plus25 dense points per eligible line on a unique nonuniform167–800nm grid. It is a synthetic spectral surrogate, not the million-pixel cooled CCD or a measured whole spectrum. Contributions of unreported elements, other transitions, line self-absorption and radiative transfer are unmodeled; element_response_available=false never establishes chemical absence.

Natural uptake withdraws finite solution into aerosol and plasma compartments with exact first-order transfer; rejected aerosol and incomplete atomization go to waste. Each declared element balances registered=donor+aerosol+plasma+waste+exhaust+removed. Carrier solution evaporation is liquid-equivalent volume, not water gas volume or full plasma reaction stoichiometry. Ar and ideal vacuum gas each balance initial=remaining+consumed.

Each complete detector window shares full spectral values and simultaneous reference-flank background. Integrals use actual window lengths; matched observed blank and >=3 observed multi-element standards determine per-line response. Only calibration interpolation returns concentrations; clipping/out-of-range remain null. Source concentrations are not copied to output and no original source CCD/noise is reconstructed.

Response signatures bind view, RF, gas flow, stabilization/integration/flush windows and background. Selected line subset and repeat count may change without invalidating already observed full-line blank/covering curve. Dilution is explicit external host preparation, not an installed automatic diluter. All repeats retained; no hidden outlier deletion or negative-area clipping.

Historical asynchronous results are owner protected and immutable after later acquisitions/method changes or record deletion. Queries do not consume time or random numbers. Storage256results/32curves and20000trace-points are engineering bounds; no reboot persistence or OS-level isolation claim.

Published application options (autosampler, pump and online Y internal standard), exact original line/matrix/RF/view protocols, full OEM interference correction, certified response/noise/LOD/precision convergence, real hardware/HIL and reverse robot contact remain not_run. The current standard aqueous model does not install organic-solvent special Ar/O2 hardware.

limitations: ICPMS-2030 uses sequential quadrupole mass selection with single-charge atomic-ion proxy; integer mass numbers5–260 are dimensionless, not a mislabeled SI m/z axis. Relative neutral atomic masses and natural representative abundances are evaluated references, not measured sample isotope composition or detector gain.

RF27MHz and maximum1400W documented; +/-0.3% RF specification is not concentration noise or detector repeatability. Main unit870x645x587mm145kg follows specified guide; brochure140kg and excluded protrusions preserved separately.6kVA supply is not absorbed RF heat.

Standard four-channel peristaltic pump and automatic torch XYZ adjustment are documented. Only sample/drain channels are modeled; two others geometrically idle. XYZ+/-3mm, cover1.7rad is instantaneous trusted-host mechanical repositioning, not a powered hinge trajectory; pump volume per radian and rates are engineering proxies. Online internal-standard mixing kit/autosampler absent; explicit host premixing loads final sample volume, not hidden additional volume.

Natural atom fractions convert to isotope mass fractions x_i*M_i/sum(x_j*M_j), not direct multiplication of elemental mass by abundance. Atomic mass kg uses cited CODATA2022 m_u. All isotope nuclear masses balance through donor/aerosol/plasma/waste/exhaust/removed; electron charge, molecular products and individual stochastic ion conservation are not solved.

Only unambiguous source solution concentrations or documented weighed/digested values may load. Ambiguous EPA ppb mass/volume basis remains query-only; density is never assumed1.0 silently.0–100kg/m3 numeric range per element and400isotope warehouses are model bounds, not OEM analytical range.

Only configured integer mass channels are observed in sequential settling/dwell windows. Isobars add in a common channel; inferred target concentration becomes null when the public isotope catalog contains an unresolved same-mass candidate, regardless of hidden sample composition. Unknown matrix, extra isotopes/molecular or double-charge interferences are not automatically identified. Synthetic host interference-rate inputs are not empirical source spectra.

Ion counts arise from transported isotope atoms times assumed ionization, transmission, efficiency, RF and alignment factors. He attenuates atomic and supplied interference components with independent assumed coefficients; this is not validated OEM collision/KED chemistry. Relative isotope masses/abundance/Aki are never concentration-response calibration coefficients.

Counts are Poisson samples when enabled, otherwise rounded expected counts for deterministic numerical checks. Dead time uses an assumed nonparalyzable detector relation; inversion uses the same explicit host tau and becomes unavailable near saturation. Counts are integers, count rates s^-1, concentration kg/m3; no radiometric W or isotope-fraction masquerading as counts.

Observed window count rates with optional dead-time correction are dwell-weighted, then matched observed blank is subtracted. Internal standard uses a separately prepared known dose and observed net rate ratio; blank intentionally excludes IS. Calibration uses >=3 actual simulated standard observations and documented prepared/certified concentrations; source values never directly populate measurement results.

Element-basis response calibrates total-element concentration, isotope basis calibrates that nuclide mass concentration under explicit natural-composition assumption. View/optics from ICP-OES are inapplicable. Calibration binds masses,dwell,sweeps,He,RF,torch alignment,IS dose and correction; only repeat count may change. Outside interpolation, saturated or unresolved-isobar results remain null; no hidden outlier deletion.

Ar/He consumption uses explicit host absolute reference T/P because source pressure/flow bases are unspecified. Coolant/exhaust booleans are host startup conditions, not real electronics validation. Single ideal vacuum chamber neglects source gas load/leaks and true split-flow turbopump stages. Bulk thermal proxy is not electron temperature. No borrowed180s maintenance timer; host cold threshold353.15K is an explicit engineering guard.

Read/describe/poll do not advance time/RNG. Only step advances finite pumping/XYZ/RF/He/transport and complete dwell events. limitations: ICPMS-2030 uses sequential quadrupole mass selection with single-charge atomic-ion proxy; integer mass numbers5–260 are dimensionless, not a mislabeled SI m/z axis. Relative neutral atomic masses and natural representative abundances are evaluated references, not measured sample isotope composition or detector gain.

RF27MHz and maximum1400W documented; +/-0.3% RF specification is not concentration noise or detector repeatability. Main unit870x645x587mm145kg follows specified guide; brochure140kg and excluded protrusions preserved separately.6kVA supply is not absorbed RF heat.

Standard four-channel peristaltic pump and automatic torch XYZ adjustment are documented. Only sample/drain channels are modeled; two others geometrically idle. XYZ+/-3mm, cover1.7rad is instantaneous trusted-host mechanical repositioning, not a powered hinge trajectory; pump volume per radian and rates are engineering proxies. Online internal-standard mixing kit/autosampler absent; explicit host premixing loads final sample volume, not hidden additional volume.

Natural atom fractions convert to isotope mass fractions x_i*M_i/sum(x_j*M_j), not direct multiplication of elemental mass by abundance. Atomic mass kg uses cited CODATA2022 m_u. All isotope nuclear masses balance through donor/aerosol/plasma/waste/exhaust/removed; electron charge, molecular products and individual stochastic ion conservation are not solved.

Only unambiguous source solution concentrations or documented weighed/digested values may load. Ambiguous EPA ppb mass/volume basis remains query-only; density is never assumed1.0 silently.0–100kg/m3 numeric range per element and400isotope warehouses are model bounds, not OEM analytical range.

Only configured integer mass channels are observed in sequential settling/dwell windows. Isobars add in a common channel; inferred target concentration becomes null when the public isotope catalog contains an unresolved same-mass candidate, regardless of hidden sample composition. Unknown matrix, extra isotopes/molecular or double-charge interferences are not automatically identified. Synthetic host interference-rate inputs are not empirical source spectra.

Ion counts arise from transported isotope atoms times assumed ionization, transmission, efficiency, RF and alignment factors. He attenuates atomic and supplied interference components with independent assumed coefficients; this is not validated OEM collision/KED chemistry. Relative isotope masses/abundance/Aki are never concentration-response calibration coefficients.

Counts are Poisson samples when enabled, otherwise rounded expected counts for deterministic numerical checks. Dead time uses an assumed nonparalyzable detector relation; inversion uses the same explicit host tau and becomes unavailable near saturation. Counts are integers, count rates s^-1, concentration kg/m3; no radiometric W or isotope-fraction masquerading as counts.

Observed window count rates with optional dead-time correction are dwell-weighted, then matched observed blank is subtracted. Internal standard uses a separately prepared known dose and observed net rate ratio; blank intentionally excludes IS. Calibration uses >=3 actual simulated standard observations and documented prepared/certified concentrations; source values never directly populate measurement results.

Element-basis response calibrates total-element concentration, isotope basis calibrates that nuclide mass concentration under explicit natural-composition assumption. View/optics from ICP-OES are inapplicable. Calibration binds masses,dwell,sweeps,He,RF,torch alignment,IS dose and correction; only repeat count may change. Outside interpolation, saturated or unresolved-isobar results remain null; no hidden outlier deletion.

Ar/He consumption uses explicit host absolute reference T/P because source pressure/flow bases are unspecified. Coolant/exhaust booleans are host startup conditions, not real electronics validation. Single ideal vacuum chamber neglects source gas load/leaks and true split-flow turbopump stages. Bulk thermal proxy is not electron temperature. No borrowed180s maintenance timer; host cold threshold353.15K is an explicit engineering guard.

Read/describe/poll do not advance time/RNG. Only step advances finite pumping/XYZ/RF/He/transport and complete dwell events. Cancel retains completed dwell windows and transferred isotope mass; partial dwell is not published as complete. Owner-protected historical operation snapshots survive later runs/record deletion. Process-local256results/32curves/20000dwell records are engineering capacities, not OEM storage or reboot persistence.

Not validated: actual OEM source response/precision/LOD, isotope tracer enrichment or isotope dilution metrology, molecular/double-charge corrections, complete collision chemistry, detector analog/pulse crossover, real pump/seals/vacuum controls, automatic tuning, optional online mixing/autosampler, Eco standby, hardware/HIL, robot contact and full parameter/noise convergence.

limitations: Source microcoulometry detects Cl/Br/I collectively as chloride equivalents, HF is not determined. Charge to chloride-equivalent conversion uses F and representative molar mass Cl; no elemental discrimination or molecular identification. Unknown source halogen proportions stay unknown.

2025 technical range10ng–1000ug combines different cells: sensitive1–100ug/1mA/20mL, high_sensitive.01–10ug/100uA/65mL, high_concentration10–1000ug/10mA/120mL. Generator current is bounded by the selected documented cell. Detection limit is not noise sigma; >5ug direct-cell RSD<2% is not a whole-process calibration.

AOX receives prepared loaded carbon; EOX a prepared extract; POX only a declared installed external purge module delivering prepared gas, without simulating extraction or purge recovery. TX uses horizontal multipurpose tube and declared ABD. TOC NDIR, ICprep halogen speciation, AOX adsorption/extraction and full autosampling are unsupported.

Temperature, finite feed/tilt, carrier flows, bulk combustion recovery, transport/cell kinetics, charge response/noise and matrix oxygen demand are explicit host assumptions. Default fast scenario does not reproduce manufacturer480–600s analyses. Source concentration/assigned mass drives synthetic physics; blind result is derived from actual observed charge and blank/reference measurements, never copied from hidden input.

End-point QC uses actual final-window current versus matched blank mean with explicit engineering threshold: max(0.001*selected-cell generator limit*host gain,5*host noise standard error). It is a limited observable tail check, not OEM electrode endpoint software or proof of zero undetected residue.

Same amount of monovalent halide precipitates one mole silver per mole equivalent, Q=F*nAg. Measured current is synthetic gain/baseline/noise applied to physical generator charge; it need not equal physical charge or certify current metrology. Unmeasured carrier/matrix composition is not silently assigned O, C or water.

Gross consumed sample plus declared reacted oxygen enters explicitly uncharacterized reaction products and residue; independent halogen-equivalent and optional supplied Cl/Br/I/F mole ledgers track remaining/released/removed material. No detailed CO2/H2O/sulfur chemistry, acid-drying chemistry, actual dose, acid volume or electrolyte activity model.

Cold maintenance requires power off/gas off/cooling per manual; exact numerical cold threshold is engineering. Three doors are independently host repositioned. Tilt alone does not replace tubes or gas/acid plumbing: tube.configure requires explicit cold installation. Default sensitive-cell geometry is a proxy; changing cell configuration is not physical glassware replacement or validated CAD.

ABD optional installed hardware has finite carriage and flap proxies, PORT locked during measurement, emergency STOP latched until ABD off/on; no flame sensor option or automatic optimization. Horizontal liquid/EOX boats have the documented minimum200s cooldown after combustion, counted only once the boat is back in the cooled sluice; fixture does not shorten it. Step is sole clock. Robot, OEM electronics and real force/temperature response remain not_run.

Cancellation preserves all generated/observed partial charge and irreversible burned material, plus unburned sample/gas/cell residual. sample.unload returns only unburned material and explicitly separated residue; product.drain disposes remaining equivalents without regenerating silver. No implicit sample restoration.

Public calibration references must be actual saved complete standard observations in this instance, with exact acquisition signature and three distinct source-reference doses. Linear calibration is conditional and interpolation-only; negative and uncalibrated values remain null with diagnostics, not forced zero. Reference aliquot fractions require explicit preparation assumption.

Process-local256 result/32curve/10000window capacity is engineering, not documented OEM persistence. Owner-bound asynchronous terminal snapshots remain queryable after new measurement and result deletion. Agent/evaluator return filtering is not OS/container/filesystem isolation.

Body nominal.810W*.550D*.460H m/about30kg plus installedABD.520W*.500D*.210H m10kg are distinct documented items; horizontal system spaceabout1.4m wide. Real local CAD, masses, gas connections and chemistry/hardware/robot validation remain separate.

Published compound-recovery templates (EPA SW-846 9020B/9021/9023, Ding et al. 2022 Se Pu, ES&T 2023 SI, Thermo AN-72333, multi X SP_0041, DIN 38409-59 validation document AOCl/AOBr/AOI by combustion IC) load as prepared inputs: delivered Cl-equivalent = source basis x source aliquot x derived stoichiometric/halide Cl-equivalent factor x published recovery, recomputed and mode-checked at load (RECOVERY_MODE_MISMATCH, RECOVERY_DERIVATION_MISMATCH). Most recoveries were measured on other TOX/AOX/CIC instruments; the host combustion_recovery still applies on top, so outputs are not replays of the published recoveries.

model_effects.description_zh: 需独立几何及实际场景绑定验证，查询没有模型运动

execution.completion_criterion: 原子返回；运动和物理仅由step推进
execution.partial_failure_zh: 保留消耗物料、Hg各仓及完整/部分吸光窗口；不会恢复已燃烧样品

limitations: DMA-80 evo Double Beam is one low-pressure mercury lamp with sample/reference beams180 degrees apart and two UV photodiodes at253.65nm; it is not the three-detector Tricell. A=-log10(corrected sample/reference ratio). Intensities are relative, not watts or recovered OEM ADC values.

Only total elemental mercury mass is determined. No methylmercury/inorganic mercury or other molecular speciation. Real reference scalar masses/fractions may drive conditioned sample input but never become instrument readouts without actual synthetic optical observations and observed calibration.

LOD0.001ng=1e-15kg is a source specification, not noise sigma. Documented0.01–1500ng=1e-14..1.5e-9kg is the available analytical range; user range_min/max only select a subset, not unverified factory cell switches. Precision<=1% at5ng is not a complete response/noise model.

Reported uncertainty_kg is only standard-fit residual SD divided by observed sensitivity, not propagated certificate/aliquot uncertainty or a complete uncertainty budget. Three or more actual saved source-standard peak integrals fit a declared linear subrange. This is not the OEM full calibration recommendation of at least10points, nonlinear/S-curve behavior or Tricell cell0/1/2 calibration. Negative, missing calibration, poor optical signals, tail excess or out-of-range results remain null with diagnostics.

Forty separate occupied sample positions and sequential assays are modeled. The one empty moving boat is a host-loaded transfer fixture proxy with a safe reference clearance above the carousel. No dynamic attachment/real gripping between slot and fixture, forty-sample visibility, robot handling or exact pneumatic kinematics is claimed.

Routine loading uses the independent transparent dust cover with the main maintenance cover closed. The main cover requires cold power-off access and the dust cover closed. Dust-cover operations require idle sequencing, stationary carousel and a home transfer fixture; measuring and indexing require it closed. These conservative model guards do not establish OEM hardware interlocks or implement on-the-fly loading/preprocessing of ten queued samples.

Gas means an already collected Hg sorbent trap installed by a trusted host with the declared external trap option. Direct gas flow sampling, sampled air volume and conversion to air mercury concentration are not implemented. Liquids require a declared quartz boat and explicit positive host volume; Hg mass-fraction references do not imply a liquid density.

Temperature configuration bounds and the short example durations/ramp rates are explicit numerical-fixture assumptions, not undocumented factory hardware limits. Dry-mass source references require an explicit host dry_mass_fraction; actual weighed mass and liquid volume remain independent. Source minimum sample sizes/homogeneity and reference conditions are not automatically validated by this model. Drying removes a declared fraction of non-Hg matrix; thermal decomposition releases declared Hg into a finite transport/catalyst compartment, gold retains Hg up to a host capacity, thermal release sends Hg into a well-mixed optical cell and carrier exhaust. Matrix oxygen demand/recovery, temperature rates, capacities, residence times and absorption coefficients are explicit host assumptions, not factory kinetics or molecular reaction validation.

Gas uses explicit oxygen mol/s and finite inventory. Actual optical-cell ideal-gas residence derives from its declared volume,absolute pressure and temperature; source ca100mL/min and4bar lack reference T/P or pressure basis, so they are not silently converted into these host quantities. Optional air carrier is not implemented.

Each completed window averages two physical-model beam intensities before logarithmic conversion; intensity noise is sampled only on a completed/partial-cancel window. Both beams share lamp drift, with declared dark/background factors. No detector counts, original time arrays or absolute radiometry claimed. Saturation/low light protect undefined logarithms.

Public final-window excess against matched blank is a limited engineering tail QC, not OEM endpoint software or an oracle about hidden Hg. Cancellation retains burned matrix, Hg in catalyst/gold/cell, consumed carrier, partial observed windows and all previous sequence results; mobile/cell Hg continues carrier-driven transport while gas remains on, even outside acquisitions; cleanup moves residue to waste without recreating samples.

Gross sample plus reacted oxygen balances remaining/returned sample,residue and explicitly uncharacterized reaction products. Hg has a separate elemental balance across held/returned,transport,gold,optical cell,exhaust,unrecovered and disposed compartments. These are different ledgers, not a claim to identify all products or avoid real Hg contamination.

Body dimensions.800W*.420D*.300H m have source support; conflicting56kg and84kg masses remain unknown/null, as explicitly required. Local CAD,part masses,thermal parameters,friction and seal dimensions are unknown. Six numeric regions are a simulation-only UI; original separate6.5inch control terminal/GUI is not reproduced by these readings.

Only host step advances all temperature,transport,motion and observation windows. Session returns and errors enforce process-local roles, request deduplication and owner-bound historical terminal snapshots. This does not prove OS/filesystem separation, restart persistence, OEM hardware/native protocol or Isaac/Blender/robot integration; those require independent reports.
