limitations: DMA-80 evo Double Beam is one low-pressure mercury lamp with sample/reference beams180 degrees apart and two UV photodiodes at253.65nm; it is not the three-detector Tricell. A=-log10(corrected sample/reference ratio). Intensities are relative, not watts or recovered OEM ADC values.

Only total elemental mercury mass is determined. No methylmercury/inorganic mercury or other molecular speciation. Real reference scalar masses/fractions may drive conditioned sample input but never become instrument readouts without actual synthetic optical observations and observed calibration.

LOD0.001ng=1e-15kg is a source specification, not noise sigma. Documented0.01–1500ng=1e-14..1.5e-9kg is the available analytical range; user range_min/max only select a subset, not unverified factory cell switches. Precision<=1% at5ng is not a complete response/noise model.

Reported uncertainty_kg is only standard-fit residual SD divided by observed sensitivity, not propagated certificate/aliquot uncertainty or a complete uncertainty budget. Three or more actual saved source-standard peak integrals fit a declared linear subrange. This is not the OEM full calibration recommendation of at least10points, nonlinear/S-curve behavior or Tricell cell0/1/2 calibration. Negative, missing calibration, poor optical signals, tail excess or out-of-range results remain null with diagnostics.

Forty separate occupied sample positions and sequential assays are modeled. The one empty moving boat is a host-loaded transfer fixture proxy with a safe reference clearance above the carousel. No dynamic attachment/real gripping between slot and fixture, forty-sample visibility, robot handling or exact pneumatic kinematics is claimed.

Routine loading uses the independent transparent dust cover with the main maintenance cover closed. The main cover requires cold power-off access and the dust cover closed. Dust-cover operations require idle sequencing, stationary carousel and a home transfer fixture; measuring and indexing require it closed. These conservative model guards do not establish OEM hardware interlocks or implement on-the-fly loading/preprocessing of ten queued samples.

Gas means an already collected Hg sorbent trap installed by a trusted host with the declared external trap option. Direct gas flow sampling, sampled air volume and conversion to air mercury concentration are not implemented. Liquids require a declared quartz boat and explicit positive host volume; Hg mass-fraction references do not imply a liquid density.

Temperature configuration bounds and the short example durations/ramp rates are explicit numerical-fixture assumptions, not undocumented factory hardware limits. Dry-mass source references require an explicit host dry_mass_fraction; actual weighed mass and liquid volume remain independent. Source minimum sample sizes/homogeneity and reference conditions are not automatically validated by this model. Drying removes a declared fraction of non-Hg matrix; thermal decomposition releases declared Hg into a finite transport/catalyst compartment, gold retains Hg up to a host capacity, thermal release sends Hg into a well-mixed optical cell and carrier exhaust. Matrix oxygen demand/recovery, temperature rates, capacities, residence times and absorption coefficients are explicit host assumptions, not factory kinetics or molecular reaction validation.

Gas uses explicit oxygen mol/s and finite inventory. Actual optical-cell ideal-gas residence derives from its declared volume,absolute pressure and temperature; source ca100mL/min and4bar lack reference T/P or pressure basis, so they are not silently converted into these host quantities. Optional air carrier is not implemented.

Each completed window averages two physical-model beam intensities before logarithmic conversion; intensity noise is sampled only on a completed/partial-cancel window. Both beams share lamp drift, with declared dark/background factors. No detector counts, original time arrays or absolute radiometry claimed. Saturation/low light protect undefined logarithms.

Public final-window excess against matched blank is a limited engineering tail QC, not OEM endpoint software or an oracle about hidden Hg. Cancellation retains burned matrix, Hg in catalyst/gold/cell, consumed carrier, partial observed windows and all previous sequence results; mobile/cell Hg continues carrier-driven transport while gas remains on, even outside acquisitions; cleanup moves residue to waste without recreating samples.

Gross sample plus reacted oxygen balances remaining/returned sample,residue and explicitly uncharacterized reaction products. Hg has a separate elemental balance across held/returned,transport,gold,optical cell,exhaust,unrecovered and disposed compartments. These are different ledgers, not a claim to identify all products or avoid real Hg contamination.

Body dimensions.800W*.420D*.300H m have source support; conflicting56kg and84kg masses remain unknown/null, as explicitly required. Local CAD,part masses,thermal parameters,friction and seal dimensions are unknown. Six numeric regions are a simulation-only UI; original separate6.5inch control terminal/GUI is not reproduced by these readings.

Only host step advances all temperature,transport,motion and observation windows. Session returns and errors enforce process-local roles, request deduplication and owner-bound historical terminal snapshots. This does not prove OS/filesystem separation, restart persistence, OEM hardware/native protocol or Isaac/Blender/robot integration; those require independent reports.

limitations: RGA100 standard Faraday cup, nominal m/z1–100 relative to u/e. Result separately converts m/z to kg/C with cached CODATA2022 u=1.66053906892e-27kg and exact e=1.602176634e-19C. A fragment at14 can be a different ion or a multiply charged ion; the model never interprets nominal m/z as the mass of a neutral molecule. Electron multiplier hardware, native binary transport and native unfiltered total-ion-current pressure mode are not implemented.

Full reference EI spectra retain source base-peak normalization and all original peaks. Contributions outside1–100 are excluded without renormalizing. Original electron energy, source geometry, isotope fragmentation and actual instrument-specific transmission are not established for these records. Host acceptance of unknown conditions is mandatory. A fixed reference shape with explicit host sensitivity and a Gaussian quadrupole profile is a conditioned numerical model, not calibrated fragmentation at any25–105V electron energy or focus setting. Same source species can share unresolved nominal masses.

FCN2 sensitivity2e-4A/Torr at70V electrons/12V ions/1mA emission/1u width at10percent height is a source anchor only. Different species gains, focus/energy dependencies and absolute transfer are unknown host assumptions. The source better-than0.5u resolution specification has different conditions. FCminimum5e-11Torr is not noise sigma. Quantification is restricted to actual observed standard interpolation and the source1e-5Torr linear domain. The1e-4Torr operating threshold is a distinct protection limit.

NF0–7 durations use the source table: analogseconds/u divided by10–25points/u; inclusive endpoints add the final actual window. Histogram/MID perform7 actual subwindows at±0.3u and return the maximum for each completed group. Equal subdivision of total single-mass time is an engineering assumption; firmware settling allocation is unknown. Exported miniscan subpoints are additional synthetic model telemetry, not actual native RS232 output. Histogram/MID calibration and inference use only the reported maximum per group. A public max-of-summed-candidate forward model and its active-peak Jacobian handle mixture nonlinearity; seven internal currents do not increase observable rank. Analog uses its actual reported windows. Finite cycles only; continuous scans remain unsupported.

Noise uses source average reference baseline SD at eachNF multiplied by an explicit host scale; source averages do not calibrate a particular unit. A single random draw is applied only to a completed or cancelled partial window. Applying a scaled table SD to individual miniscan subwindows is an explicit synthetic noise assumption, not the original instrument internal-noise allocation. All source current responses and time arrays are synthetic; no OEM electronic raw data exist here. The high-level typed protocol intentionally permits pure queries during scans, unlike native firmware commands that interrupt streaming. No claim of native timing, binary ADC quantization,675Hz electronics protection, RS232 throughput or real instrument validation.

An internal zero is the explicit host electronic dark offset under no-input electronics; it is not a gas blank. Analog/histogram autozero, while MID uses the retained zero. Separate actual gas-blank scans and at least3 distinct observed pure-gas pressure-standard scans fit eachA/Pa sensitivity. Standard pressures are host-prepared from declared mol,V,T, not measured or certified pressures from the EI library. Blank/signature, source library and public response settings match. Candidate species are public and independent of hidden composition. Rank/conditioning with an explicit host condition-number ceiling (default1000; conservative numerical identifiability rather than a factory specification), residual, negative/unobserved range, detector saturation or drifting pressure cause honest null results.

Total inferred partial pressure sums only declared, calibrated candidates when all pass QC; it does not prove unknown-gas completeness. Mass concentration is inferred partial pressure times source molar mass divided by hostR*T. Source molar masses and EI intensities are references, not concentration measurements. Underlying unconstrained least-squares values are explicit diagnostics even when scientific output is null, with no silent negative clipping.

Host chamber is an explicit ideal-gas vessel, not a built-in RGA pump. Independent host pressure feedback is ideal and must not be presented as native RGA identified total pressure. Trusted batch exchange moves prior residual gas to a named conceptual host-return inventory and registers new finite mol amounts; no RGA gas-sampling inlet is invented. External gate and pump cause finite species transport. Degas transfers finite adsorbed species into the chamber. Chambers,pumped gas,returned gas and adsorbed inventories close per-species mol and mass ledgers. The Faraday diagnostic is treated as non-perturbing at these low sampled ion currents: ion extraction/neutralization and fragment-specific consumption are not modeled or claimed as a charge-to-parent-gas balance. No chemical conversion, atmospheric sampling, reactor reaction kinetics or uncontrolled gas leak identification is claimed.

Degas has actualsource400V and1–20mA emission over60s, then constant20mA to1–20minutes. Its8W electron-beam power is not whole-system input power or an independent arbitrary1–10W setting. Finite desorption mol/J, thermal capacity and heat rejection are host assumptions. Cancellation retains released gases, pumping and heat and restores pre-degas normal emission only if safe. The scene demonstrates early degassing and cancellation instead of mislabeling an accelerated complete manufacturer cycle.

Normal emission0–3.5mA and ion energy8/12V are separate from the400V/20mA degas exception. Overpressure at1e-4Torr stops emission and running acquisitions, preserving partial observations and inventories. Opening host valves and finite pumping are external operations. Cold power-off ECU withdrawal is host-supported engineering motion, not an OEM motor. Cold323.15K example is an engineering threshold; source ECU operating70C and probe bake300C withoutECU are distinct, and bake is not implemented.

Eight visible source LEDs have limited modeled semantics. Power requires explicit24V supply within22–26V. Filament also lights during degas, EM is false for standardFC. Overpressure and declared-host filament integrity are modeled, not full filament aging/Thoria diagnostics. Error covers this model only. RS232activity is null because high-level API traffic does not establish native TX/RX. No scan-busy impersonation of theRS232LED. External six numeric regions are simulation-only and hidden in product views, not an original LCD.

All physical motion, gas transport, heat and acquisition windows advance only in step. Parameter and host-transfer actions are atomic at the command boundary; pure read/describe do not advance time. Session role checks, same-request deduplication and owner-bound operation receipts are process-local guarantees, not OS isolation, persistence or physical robot/hardware evidence. Scene,geometry,light-material and native bridge evidence must come from separate actual reports.

limitations: RGA100 standard Faraday cup, nominal m/z1–100 relative to u/e. Result separately converts m/z to kg/C with cached CODATA2022 u=1.66053906892e-27kg and exact e=1.602176634e-19C. A fragment at14 can be a different ion or a multiply charged ion; the model never interprets nominal m/z as the mass of a neutral molecule. Electron multiplier hardware, native binary transport and native unfiltered total-ion-current pressure mode are not implemented.

Full reference EI spectra retain source base-peak normalization and all original peaks. Contributions outside1–100 are excluded without renormalizing. Original electron energy, source geometry, isotope fragmentation and actual instrument-specific transmission are not established for these records. Host acceptance of unknown conditions is mandatory. A fixed reference shape with explicit host sensitivity and a Gaussian quadrupole profile is a conditioned numerical model, not calibrated fragmentation at any25–105V electron energy or focus setting. Same source species can share unresolved nominal masses.

FCN2 sensitivity2e-4A/Torr at70V electrons/12V ions/1mA emission/1u width at10percent height is a source anchor only. Different species gains, focus/energy dependencies and absolute transfer are unknown host assumptions. The source better-than0.5u resolution specification has different conditions. FCminimum5e-11Torr is not noise sigma. Quantification is restricted to actual observed standard interpolation and the source1e-5Torr linear domain. The1e-4Torr operating threshold is a distinct protection limit.

NF0–7 durations use the source table: analogseconds/u divided by10–25points/u; inclusive endpoints add the final actual window. Histogram/MID perform7 actual subwindows at±0.3u and return the maximum for each completed group. Equal subdivision of total single-mass time is an engineering assumption; firmware settling allocation is unknown. Exported miniscan subpoints are additional synthetic model telemetry, not actual native RS232 output. Histogram/MID calibration and inference use only the reported maximum per group. A public max-of-summed-candidate forward model and its active-peak Jacobian handle mixture nonlinearity; seven internal currents do not increase observable rank. Analog uses its actual reported windows. Finite cycles only; continuous scans remain unsupported.

Noise uses source average reference baseline SD at eachNF multiplied by an explicit host scale; source averages do not calibrate a particular unit. A single random draw is applied only to a completed or cancelled partial window. Applying a scaled table SD to individual miniscan subwindows is an explicit synthetic noise assumption, not the original instrument internal-noise allocation. All source current responses and time arrays are synthetic; no OEM electronic raw data exist here. The high-level typed protocol intentionally permits pure queries during scans, unlike native firmware commands that interrupt streaming. No claim of native timing, binary ADC quantization,675Hz electronics protection, RS232 throughput or real instrument validation.

An internal zero is the explicit host electronic dark offset under no-input electronics; it is not a gas blank. Analog/histogram autozero, while MID uses the retained zero. Separate actual gas-blank scans and at least3 distinct observed pure-gas pressure-standard scans fit eachA/Pa sensitivity. Standard pressures are host-prepared from declared mol,V,T, not measured or certified pressures from the EI library. Blank/signature, source library and public response settings match. Candidate species are public and independent of hidden composition. Rank/conditioning with an explicit host condition-number ceiling (default1000; conservative numerical identifiability rather than a factory specification), residual, negative/unobserved range, detector saturation or drifting pressure cause honest null results.

Total inferred partial pressure sums only declared, calibrated candidates when all pass QC; it does not prove unknown-gas completeness. Mass concentration is inferred partial pressure times source molar mass divided by hostR*T. Source molar masses and EI intensities are references, not concentration measurements. Underlying unconstrained least-squares values are explicit diagnostics even when scientific output is null, with no silent negative clipping.

Host chamber is an explicit ideal-gas vessel, not a built-in RGA pump. Independent host pressure feedback is ideal and must not be presented as native RGA identified total pressure. Trusted batch exchange moves prior residual gas to a named conceptual host-return inventory and registers new finite mol amounts; no RGA gas-sampling inlet is invented. External gate and pump cause finite species transport. Degas transfers finite adsorbed species into the chamber. Chambers,pumped gas,returned gas and adsorbed inventories close per-species mol and mass ledgers. The Faraday diagnostic is treated as non-perturbing at these low sampled ion currents: ion extraction/neutralization and fragment-specific consumption are not modeled or claimed as a charge-to-parent-gas balance. No chemical conversion, atmospheric sampling, reactor reaction kinetics or uncontrolled gas leak identification is claimed.

Degas has actualsource400V and1–20mA emission over60s, then constant20mA to1–20minutes. Its8W electron-beam power is not whole-system input power or an independent arbitrary1–10W setting. Finite desorption mol/J, thermal capacity and heat rejection are host assumptions. Cancellation retains released gases, pumping and heat and restores pre-degas normal emission only if safe. The scene demonstrates early degassing and cancellation instead of mislabeling an accelerated complete manufacturer cycle.

Normal emission0–3.5mA and ion energy8/12V are separate from the400V/20mA degas exception. Overpressure at1e-4Torr stops emission and running acquisitions, preserving partial observations and inventories. Opening host valves and finite pumping are external operations. Cold power-off ECU withdrawal is host-supported engineering motion, not an OEM motor. Cold323.15K example is an engineering threshold; source ECU operating70C and probe bake300C withoutECU are distinct, and bake is not implemented.

Eight visible source LEDs have limited modeled semantics. Power requires explicit24V supply within22–26V. Filament also lights during degas, EM is false for standardFC. Overpressure and declared-host filament integrity are modeled, not full filament aging/Thoria diagnostics. Error covers this model only. RS232activity is null because high-level API traffic does not establish native TX/RX. No scan-busy impersonation of theRS232LED. External six numeric regions are simulation-only and hidden in product views, not an original LCD.

All physical motion, gas transport, heat and acquisition windows advance only in step. Parameter and host-transfer actions are atomic at the command boundary; pure read/describe do not advance time. Session role checks, same-request deduplication and owner-bound operation receipts are process-local guarantees, not OS isolation, persistence or physical robot/hardware evidence. Scene,geometry,light-material and native bridge evidence must come from separate actual reports.

limitations: RGA100 standard Faraday cup, nominal m/z1–100 relative to u/e. Result separately converts m/z to kg/C with cached CODATA2022 u=1.66053906892e-27kg and exact e=1.602176634e-19C. A fragment at14 can be a different ion or a multiply charged ion; the model never interprets nominal m/z as the mass of a neutral molecule. Electron multiplier hardware, native binary transport and native unfiltered total-ion-current pressure mode are not implemented.

Full reference EI spectra retain source base-peak normalization and all original peaks. Contributions outside1–100 are excluded without renormalizing. Original electron energy, source geometry, isotope fragmentation and actual instrument-specific transmission are not established for these records. Host acceptance of unknown conditions is mandatory. A fixed reference shape with explicit host sensitivity and a Gaussian quadrupole profile is a conditioned numerical model, not calibrated fragmentation at any25–105V electron energy or focus setting. Same source species can share unresolved nominal masses.

FCN2 sensitivity2e-4A/Torr at70V electrons/12V ions/1mA emission/1u width at10percent height is a source anchor only. Different species gains, focus/energy dependencies and absolute transfer are unknown host assumptions. The source better-than0.5u resolution specification has different conditions. FCminimum5e-11Torr is not noise sigma. Quantification is restricted to actual observed standard interpolation and the source1e-5Torr linear domain. The1e-4Torr operating threshold is a distinct protection limit.

NF0–7 durations use the source table: analogseconds/u divided by10–25points/u; inclusive endpoints add the final actual window. Histogram/MID perform7 actual subwindows at±0.3u and return the maximum for each completed group. Equal subdivision of total single-mass time is an engineering assumption; firmware settling allocation is unknown. Exported miniscan subpoints are additional synthetic model telemetry, not actual native RS232 output. Histogram/MID calibration and inference use only the reported maximum per group. A public max-of-summed-candidate forward model and its active-peak Jacobian handle mixture nonlinearity; seven internal currents do not increase observable rank. Analog uses its actual reported windows. Finite cycles only; continuous scans remain unsupported.

Noise uses source average reference baseline SD at eachNF multiplied by an explicit host scale; source averages do not calibrate a particular unit. A single random draw is applied only to a completed or cancelled partial window. Applying a scaled table SD to individual miniscan subwindows is an explicit synthetic noise assumption, not the original instrument internal-noise allocation. All source current responses and time arrays are synthetic; no OEM electronic raw data exist here. The high-level typed protocol intentionally permits pure queries during scans, unlike native firmware commands that interrupt streaming. No claim of native timing, binary ADC quantization,675Hz electronics protection, RS232 throughput or real instrument validation.

An internal zero is the explicit host electronic dark offset under no-input electronics; it is not a gas blank. Analog/histogram autozero, while MID uses the retained zero. Separate actual gas-blank scans and at least3 distinct observed pure-gas pressure-standard scans fit eachA/Pa sensitivity. Standard pressures are host-prepared from declared mol,V,T, not measured or certified pressures from the EI library. Blank/signature, source library and public response settings match. Candidate species are public and independent of hidden composition. Rank/conditioning with an explicit host condition-number ceiling (default1000; conservative numerical identifiability rather than a factory specification), residual, negative/unobserved range, detector saturation or drifting pressure cause honest null results.

Total inferred partial pressure sums only declared, calibrated candidates when all pass QC; it does not prove unknown-gas completeness. Mass concentration is inferred partial pressure times source molar mass divided by hostR*T. Source molar masses and EI intensities are references, not concentration measurements. Underlying unconstrained least-squares values are explicit diagnostics even when scientific output is null, with no silent negative clipping.

Host chamber is an explicit ideal-gas vessel, not a built-in RGA pump. Independent host pressure feedback is ideal and must not be presented as native RGA identified total pressure. Trusted batch exchange moves prior residual gas to a named conceptual host-return inventory and registers new finite mol amounts; no RGA gas-sampling inlet is invented. External gate and pump cause finite species transport. Degas transfers finite adsorbed species into the chamber. Chambers,pumped gas,returned gas and adsorbed inventories close per-species mol and mass ledgers. The Faraday diagnostic is treated as non-perturbing at these low sampled ion currents: ion extraction/neutralization and fragment-specific consumption are not modeled or claimed as a charge-to-parent-gas balance. No chemical conversion, atmospheric sampling, reactor reaction kinetics or uncontrolled gas leak identification is claimed.

Degas has actualsource400V and1–20mA emission over60s, then constant20mA to1–20minutes. Its8W electron-beam power is not whole-system input power or an independent arbitrary1–10W setting. Finite desorption mol/J, thermal capacity and heat rejection are host assumptions. Cancellation retains released gases, pumping and heat and restores pre-degas normal emission only if safe. The scene demonstrates early degassing and cancellation instead of mislabeling an accelerated complete manufacturer cycle.

Normal emission0–3.5mA and ion energy8/12V are separate from the400V/20mA degas exception. Overpressure at1e-4Torr stops emission and running acquisitions, preserving partial observations and inventories. Opening host valves and finite pumping are external operations. Cold power-off ECU withdrawal is host-supported engineering motion, not an OEM motor. Cold323.15K example is an engineering threshold; source ECU operating70C and probe bake300C withoutECU are distinct, and bake is not implemented.

Eight visible source LEDs have limited modeled semantics. Power requires explicit24V supply within22–26V. Filament also lights during degas, EM is false for standardFC. Overpressure and declared-host filament integrity are modeled, not full filament aging/Thoria diagnostics. Error covers this model only. RS232activity is null because high-level API traffic does not establish native TX/RX. No scan-busy impersonation of theRS232LED. External six numeric regions are simulation-only and hidden in product views, not an original LCD.

All physical motion, gas transport, heat and acquisition windows advance only in step. Parameter and host-transfer actions are atomic at the command boundary; pure read/describe do not advance time. Session role checks, same-request deduplication and owner-bound operation receipts are process-local guarantees, not OS isolation, persistence or physical robot/hardware evidence. Scene,geometry,light-material and native bridge evidence must come from separate actual reports.

limitations: RGA100 standard Faraday cup, nominal m/z1–100 relative to u/e. Result separately converts m/z to kg/C with cached CODATA2022 u=1.66053906892e-27kg and exact e=1.602176634e-19C. A fragment at14 can be a different ion or a multiply charged ion; the model never interprets nominal m/z as the mass of a neutral molecule. Electron multiplier hardware, native binary transport and native unfiltered total-ion-current pressure mode are not implemented.

Full reference EI spectra retain source base-peak normalization and all original peaks. Contributions outside1–100 are excluded without renormalizing. Original electron energy, source geometry, isotope fragmentation and actual instrument-specific transmission are not established for these records. Host acceptance of unknown conditions is mandatory. A fixed reference shape with explicit host sensitivity and a Gaussian quadrupole profile is a conditioned numerical model, not calibrated fragmentation at any25–105V electron energy or focus setting. Same source species can share unresolved nominal masses.

FCN2 sensitivity2e-4A/Torr at70V electrons/12V ions/1mA emission/1u width at10percent height is a source anchor only. Different species gains, focus/energy dependencies and absolute transfer are unknown host assumptions. The source better-than0.5u resolution specification has different conditions. FCminimum5e-11Torr is not noise sigma. Quantification is restricted to actual observed standard interpolation and the source1e-5Torr linear domain. The1e-4Torr operating threshold is a distinct protection limit.

NF0–7 durations use the source table: analogseconds/u divided by10–25points/u; inclusive endpoints add the final actual window. Histogram/MID perform7 actual subwindows at±0.3u and return the maximum for each completed group. Equal subdivision of total single-mass time is an engineering assumption; firmware settling allocation is unknown. Exported miniscan subpoints are additional synthetic model telemetry, not actual native RS232 output. Histogram/MID calibration and inference use only the reported maximum per group. A public max-of-summed-candidate forward model and its active-peak Jacobian handle mixture nonlinearity; seven internal currents do not increase observable rank. Analog uses its actual reported windows. Finite cycles only; continuous scans remain unsupported.

Noise uses source average reference baseline SD at eachNF multiplied by an explicit host scale; source averages do not calibrate a particular unit. A single random draw is applied only to a completed or cancelled partial window. Applying a scaled table SD to individual miniscan subwindows is an explicit synthetic noise assumption, not the original instrument internal-noise allocation. All source current responses and time arrays are synthetic; no OEM electronic raw data exist here. The high-level typed protocol intentionally permits pure queries during scans, unlike native firmware commands that interrupt streaming. No claim of native timing, binary ADC quantization,675Hz electronics protection, RS232 throughput or real instrument validation.

An internal zero is the explicit host electronic dark offset under no-input electronics; it is not a gas blank. Analog/histogram autozero, while MID uses the retained zero. Separate actual gas-blank scans and at least3 distinct observed pure-gas pressure-standard scans fit eachA/Pa sensitivity. Standard pressures are host-prepared from declared mol,V,T, not measured or certified pressures from the EI library. Blank/signature, source library and public response settings match. Candidate species are public and independent of hidden composition. Rank/conditioning with an explicit host condition-number ceiling (default1000; conservative numerical identifiability rather than a factory specification), residual, negative/unobserved range, detector saturation or drifting pressure cause honest null results.

Total inferred partial pressure sums only declared, calibrated candidates when all pass QC; it does not prove unknown-gas completeness. Mass concentration is inferred partial pressure times source molar mass divided by hostR*T. Source molar masses and EI intensities are references, not concentration measurements. Underlying unconstrained least-squares values are explicit diagnostics even when scientific output is null, with no silent negative clipping.

Host chamber is an explicit ideal-gas vessel, not a built-in RGA pump. Independent host pressure feedback is ideal and must not be presented as native RGA identified total pressure. Trusted batch exchange moves prior residual gas to a named conceptual host-return inventory and registers new finite mol amounts; no RGA gas-sampling inlet is invented. External gate and pump cause finite species transport. Degas transfers finite adsorbed species into the chamber. Chambers,pumped gas,returned gas and adsorbed inventories close per-species mol and mass ledgers. The Faraday diagnostic is treated as non-perturbing at these low sampled ion currents: ion extraction/neutralization and fragment-specific consumption are not modeled or claimed as a charge-to-parent-gas balance. No chemical conversion, atmospheric sampling, reactor reaction kinetics or uncontrolled gas leak identification is claimed.

Degas has actualsource400V and1–20mA emission over60s, then constant20mA to1–20minutes. Its8W electron-beam power is not whole-system input power or an independent arbitrary1–10W setting. Finite desorption mol/J, thermal capacity and heat rejection are host assumptions. Cancellation retains released gases, pumping and heat and restores pre-degas normal emission only if safe. The scene demonstrates early degassing and cancellation instead of mislabeling an accelerated complete manufacturer cycle.

Normal emission0–3.5mA and ion energy8/12V are separate from the400V/20mA degas exception. Overpressure at1e-4Torr stops emission and running acquisitions, preserving partial observations and inventories. Opening host valves and finite pumping are external operations. Cold power-off ECU withdrawal is host-supported engineering motion, not an OEM motor. Cold323.15K example is an engineering threshold; source ECU operating70C and probe bake300C withoutECU are distinct, and bake is not implemented.

Eight visible source LEDs have limited modeled semantics. Power requires explicit24V supply within22–26V. Filament also lights during degas, EM is false for standardFC. Overpressure and declared-host filament integrity are modeled, not full filament aging/Thoria diagnostics. Error covers this model only. RS232activity is null because high-level API traffic does not establish native TX/RX. No scan-busy impersonation of theRS232LED. External six numeric regions are simulation-only and hidden in product views, not an original LCD.

All physical motion, gas transport, heat and acquisition windows advance only in step. Parameter and host-transfer actions are atomic at the command boundary; pure read/describe do not advance time. Session role checks, same-request deduplication and owner-bound operation receipts are process-local guarantees, not OS isolation, persistence or physical robot/hardware evidence. Scene,geometry,light-material and native bridge evidence must come from separate actual reports.

power.enabled.meaning_zh: ECU供电；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

ecu.withdrawal_m.meaning_zh: 该部件可信宿主托持ECU工程有限退离，范围 0–0.08 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。
ecu.withdrawal_m.reference_conditions: 资产坐标系（+X 右、+Y 向后、+Z 上，原点台面投影中心）；关节零位为闭合/初始位，正向沿 URDF 关节轴。

ecu.target_m.meaning_zh: 宿主ECU退离目标，范围 0–0.08 m；设定值，由 ecu.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

vacuum.pressure_pa.meaning_zh: 宿主理想独立总压反馈；不是RGA已识别真实总分压，≥0 Pa；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

ionizer.temperature_k.meaning_zh: 显式工程热容量下的离子源温度代理，范围 273.15–10000 K；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

filament.enabled.meaning_zh: 正常扫描发射开关；设定值，由 filament.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

filament.emission_current_a.meaning_zh: 扫描设定/脱气爬升电子发射电流；不是离子电流，范围 0–0.02 A；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

ionizer.electron_energy_v.meaning_zh: 电子加速电势：扫描25–105V，脱气400V，范围 0–400 V；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

degas.power_w.meaning_zh: 脱气电子束功率V×A；不是整机功率，范围 0–8.0001 W；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

instrument.ready.meaning_zh: 供电/ECU/压力允许扫描；暗电流扫描不必开灯；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

method.mode.meaning_zh: analog/histogram/mid公开选择；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

method.noise_floor.meaning_zh: NF0–7，时间表有据噪声仍为宿主模型，范围 0–7；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

scan.phase.meaning_zh: 闲置/运行/完成/取消/保护终态；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

scan.stage.meaning_zh: 电子零点准备/窗口扫描/脱气步骤；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

scan.elapsed_s.meaning_zh: 实际累计模拟时间，≥0 s；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

scan.progress.meaning_zh: 有限扫描或脱气进度，范围 0–1；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

mass.current_ratio.meaning_zh: 最近实际窗口名义m/z，单位参照u/e非kg；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

mass.current_kg_c.meaning_zh: 名义m/z乘固定CODATA2022 u/e；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

detector.current_a.meaning_zh: 扣电子零点后的实际Faraday窗口平均电流；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

sampling.window_description: Actual completed or partial-cancel Faraday integration window; query clock is not sample time.

detector.last_sample_time_s.meaning_zh: 最近真实电流窗口终点；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

detector.zero_current_a.meaning_zh: 内部电子零点，不是气体背景；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

result.total_partial_pressure_pa.meaning_zh: 已校准公开候选分压之和；不是本机无筛选总压模式；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

blank.valid.meaning_zh: 本方法/响应匹配的真实观察空白；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

calibration.ready.meaning_zh: 公开候选皆有相容响应标线；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

led.filament.meaning_zh: 普通发射或脱气发射；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

led.degas.meaning_zh: 脱气过程中；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

led.overpressure.meaning_zh: 开灯或脱气时实际总压保护已触发；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

led.filament_fault.meaning_zh: 宿主明确声明灯丝不完整，非Thoria老化识别；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

led.rs232_active.meaning_zh: 原生TX/RX未接入为null，不用扫描busy代替；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

limitations: Configuration is Orbitrap Exploris120 with OptaMaxNG H-ESI and S-lens, AABG, segmentedquadrupole, C-trap, charge detector, nitrogen-filledIRM and Orbitrap analyzer. IRM fills/cools before return toC-trap and Orbitrap injection. No moving quadrupole or analyzer scanning mechanism, linear ion trap, built-inLC, APCI/FAIMS option, fullDDA/DIA or hardware API is claimed.

FullMS range40–3000 obeys lastmass<=15*firstmass. For firstmass>2500, source says ioncollection2500–lastmass while displayed spectrum starts atrequestedmass. MS2 precursor40–2500, segmentedminimumwidth.4/.7/1/1.5/2/3 over documented bands, maximumwidth5; the broad specification .4–2000 describes a differentisolation context. Native dimensionless m/z refers to u/e; kg/C=mz*CODATA2022u/e, not neutralmasskg. Library supports single positive/negative adduct ions only.

Software supports15000/22500/30000/45000/60000/90000/120000. R(m)=R200/sqrt(m/200). Gaussian FWHM=m/R is a host profile approximation; it cannot recover unresolved information from source35000 processed centroids. Source maximum22/12/7/3Hz at15/30/60/120k are ceilings under sourceconditions. Numerical sequentialtransient/fill/transfer/settling values are explicit hostfixtures, not OEM timing or parallel AGC acquisition. Midresolution timing has no independentlyreported rate anchor.

AGC100percent means nominal1e6 chargesFullMS or1e5MS2; percentage input converted to fraction, rangesFull1e-5–10 andMS2to30. Finite parentmoles, host ionization/transfer efficiencies and elapsedfill produce stored charge; target or maxinjectiontime ends filling. Imagecurrent-relative amplitude is not an actual measured ioncount/current or concentration. Unknown charge-state/adduct equilibria and matrix-dependentESI response are not inferred.

Fixed HCD NCE1–200percent and absolutepotential1–200V are distinct. NCE has no invented eV conversion. CurrentCASMI references report35NCE while citedpaper reportsstepped20/35/50. Sourceinstrument QExactivePlus and35000resolution differ. MS2 requires explicitlyselected acknowledged_fixed_pattern and trusted accept_transferred_reference for the fixed conditioned shape; defaultmatching_energy never implies this conflict is resolved. Under strict mode unsupported sourceenergy responses are unmodeled and absence is not established. Exactfragmentation/neutral-lossstoichiometry/collisiongasdynamics are not claimed.

Real MS2 arrays are processed/recalibrated MassBank ESI/HCD centroid references, not raw detector electronics. MS1 natural-isotope distributions are derived from publicformulas/NIST isotope data, not measured sourceMS1. The generator keeps originalsourcebase normalization and samples a coarse publicbackground plus dense windows around all eligible publiclibrary peaks above1e-4relative. Helium and argon are separate methods, no carrier changeover during a run. 1g is manufacturer nominal sample mass; this implementation restricts gross mass to0–1g as an explicit engineering scope, not a claimed maximumhardwarecapacity.

O absolute range5e-11–5e-5kg; N He5e-11–3e-5kg versusAr2e-10–3e-5kg; H1e-10–2.5e-6kg. OEM lowerlimit is2blankdeviations andprecision1blankdeviation or statedRSD; these aggregate figures are not the synthetic noise sigma. All range checks apply inferredresults, never hidden sample mass content.

Power0–7500W is impulsefurnace electricalpower, not totalinstrumentheat. Source490cc/min referenceT/P and22psi pressurebasis unspecified; host supplies explicit gasreference pressure/temperature for m3/s→mol/s. Source85–130s analysis and180–210scycle dependcarrier/analyte. Numerical shortdurations, thermalcapacity/cooling/conversionrates/gain/noise are declared hostfixtures, not acceleratedproof ofsourceperformance.

Graphite consumes carbon as sampleO becomes CO/CO2; the host fixes CO branchfraction. CuO consumes separate reagentoxygen converting CO→CO2 and H2→H2O andproducesCu. SampleO does not include reagentO. Gaschannels are a linear response convention: co=gO*MO*nCO,co2low=2*gO*MO*nCO2post,co2high=2*gO*MO*nCO2pre; CO/highCO2 are beforeCuO andlowCO2/H2O afterCuO. O response=co2low-co. This uses the combinedCO/CO2 information without counting reagentoxygen as sampleoxygen. Hresponse=gH*2MH*nH2O, Nresponse=gN*2MN*nN2. These are relative surrogate outputs, not OEM IRabsorbance/current electronics or measured gainratio.

Finite analyte/blank release and common transport use a two-compartment linear exact exponential overconstantpower stages. Outgasrate scaleswithP/6000W andfusionratewithP/4800W;0Woutgas causes no blankrelease. These powerproxies are not an Arrhenius/thermalmelting model, even though thermalenergy separately closes. CuOreaction anddownstreamNDIR/scrubbingaftertransport are zeroadditionalresidencetime engineeringapproximations. O/N/H elementalbooks, carboninput/out/disposed, CuOoxygen/copper, capturedCO2/H2O, carrierHe/Ar andDFCsupply are explicit. Unknownmatrix remainsunspecifiedresidue; no oxide/mineralphases orunreportedO/N/H contributions are synthesized.

CO2/H2O sorbent capacities are finite molar-equivalent capacities, not an invented reagentmass. Named source magnesiumperchlorate is Mg(ClO4)2; schematic MgClO4 is not used as a chemicalformula. Sodiumhydroxide supportchemistry/copperturningdetails andreal scrubbing breakthrough kinetics are not solved. DFCadds actual samecarrier moles matching removedCO2/H2O up to explicit hostcapacity; deficit flags invalidanalysis, no OEM feedback dynamics claimed.

Gross weighing and publicdeclared_elements represent hostinputs. Records withunreported values retain null andunknownremainder; declaredunreported channels returnunavailable regardless syntheticbackground. Source drymass requires explicit dryfraction; source minimumaliquot is respected where known. Existing metals/ceramics are source references, not molecularspeciation. Ni fluxbasket andadditionalgraphite orsource matrices are conditiontransfers, not automaticallyinstalledhardware or demonstratedcompletefusion.

Every assay collects actual preanalysisbaseline windows, then dropgate andfusion/tailwindows. Savedmatchingcrucibleblank subtracts actualintegratedbackground. >=3distinctmass observedstandardrecords fitresponsearea versus publicreferenceelementmass using leastsquares. No directtruth-to-result, no arbitraryexternal observations trustedasactualrecords. Calibrations bindcarrier/method/response/library; interpolationonly, endpoint/saturation/reagent/incomplete/negative/rangefail produce null. Certificate/source uncertainty is retained inlibrary but not a validatedmeasurement uncertainty budget.

Four finite mechanisms are loadheadmaintenancecover+Z.160m,loading slide+Y.045m,lowerreleasegate+Y.040m,andlower electrode−Z.100m. Cover travel 0.160 m is an engineering estimate: photo-reconstructed cover top is approximately 0.840 m, exposed rear filter tubes set the 0.915 m nominal overall height, and opened cover reaches the source 1.000 m envelope. The OEM specifies overall heights, not cover stroke. Local travels, speeds and cold threshold are engineering proxies. Fixedupper electrode is not lowered. Routine loading usesloadingfunnel withmaintenancecoverclosed. No20-positionautoloader/autocleaner/realparticletrajectory orrobotpickup is implemented. Crucibleinstalled bool supports separatevisualbinding, not actual roboticinsertion.

Gas/coolantloss andlogicalpowerstop haltongoingfusion andretainconsumption andpartialwindows. Remainingtransport mayflush under continuedcarrier, unreleasedmaterial staysincrucible, anddiscardmovesit todisposedbooks. Only predrop heldsample mayreturn as originalmaterial. Coldunloadingtemperature is explicit numericalthreshold, not OEM electronicinterlockcertification.

All physics andfinite motion advance solely viahoststep; purequery/describe do notconsume oradvance. Atomiccommandrejection restores randomgenerator andstate. Authenticatedper-instance Sessionsupports filteredagent/evaluator views, requestdedup/conflict andownedpoll/cancel. 256records/64curves are engineeringin-memorylimits, not OEMstorage; no cross-processpersistence/OSisolation orhardwareprotocol claim.

limitations: ONH836-C analyzer without touch-screen/PC geometry. One inert-gas graphite-crucible fusion measures O/N/H simultaneously. Helium and argon are separate methods, no carrier changeover during a run. 1g is manufacturer nominal sample mass; this implementation restricts gross mass to0–1g as an explicit engineering scope, not a claimed maximumhardwarecapacity.

O absolute range5e-11–5e-5kg; N He5e-11–3e-5kg versusAr2e-10–3e-5kg; H1e-10–2.5e-6kg. OEM lowerlimit is2blankdeviations andprecision1blankdeviation or statedRSD; these aggregate figures are not the synthetic noise sigma. All range checks apply inferredresults, never hidden sample mass content.

Power0–7500W is impulsefurnace electricalpower, not totalinstrumentheat. Source490cc/min referenceT/P and22psi pressurebasis unspecified; host supplies explicit gasreference pressure/temperature for m3/s→mol/s. Source85–130s analysis and180–210scycle dependcarrier/analyte. Numerical shortdurations, thermalcapacity/cooling/conversionrates/gain/noise are declared hostfixtures, not acceleratedproof ofsourceperformance.

Graphite consumes carbon as sampleO becomes CO/CO2; the host fixes CO branchfraction. CuO consumes separate reagentoxygen converting CO→CO2 and H2→H2O andproducesCu. SampleO does not include reagentO. Gaschannels are a linear response convention: co=gO*MO*nCO,co2low=2*gO*MO*nCO2post,co2high=2*gO*MO*nCO2pre; CO/highCO2 are beforeCuO andlowCO2/H2O afterCuO. O response=co2low-co. This uses the combinedCO/CO2 information without counting reagentoxygen as sampleoxygen. Hresponse=gH*2MH*nH2O, Nresponse=gN*2MN*nN2. These are relative surrogate outputs, not OEM IRabsorbance/current electronics or measured gainratio.

Finite analyte/blank release and common transport use a two-compartment linear exact exponential overconstantpower stages. Outgasrate scaleswithP/6000W andfusionratewithP/4800W;0Woutgas causes no blankrelease. These powerproxies are not an Arrhenius/thermalmelting model, even though thermalenergy separately closes. CuOreaction anddownstreamNDIR/scrubbingaftertransport are zeroadditionalresidencetime engineeringapproximations. O/N/H elementalbooks, carboninput/out/disposed, CuOoxygen/copper, capturedCO2/H2O, carrierHe/Ar andDFCsupply are explicit. Unknownmatrix remainsunspecifiedresidue; no oxide/mineralphases orunreportedO/N/H contributions are synthesized.

CO2/H2O sorbent capacities are finite molar-equivalent capacities, not an invented reagentmass. Named source magnesiumperchlorate is Mg(ClO4)2; schematic MgClO4 is not used as a chemicalformula. Sodiumhydroxide supportchemistry/copperturningdetails andreal scrubbing breakthrough kinetics are not solved. DFCadds actual samecarrier moles matching removedCO2/H2O up to explicit hostcapacity; deficit flags invalidanalysis, no OEM feedback dynamics claimed.

Gross weighing and publicdeclared_elements represent hostinputs. Records withunreported values retain null andunknownremainder; declaredunreported channels returnunavailable regardless syntheticbackground. Source drymass requires explicit dryfraction; source minimumaliquot is respected where known. Existing metals/ceramics are source references, not molecularspeciation. Ni fluxbasket andadditionalgraphite orsource matrices are conditiontransfers, not automaticallyinstalledhardware or demonstratedcompletefusion.

Every assay collects actual preanalysisbaseline windows, then dropgate andfusion/tailwindows. Savedmatchingcrucibleblank subtracts actualintegratedbackground. >=3distinctmass observedstandardrecords fitresponsearea versus publicreferenceelementmass using leastsquares. No directtruth-to-result, no arbitraryexternal observations trustedasactualrecords. Calibrations bindcarrier/method/response/library; interpolationonly, endpoint/saturation/reagent/incomplete/negative/rangefail produce null. Certificate/source uncertainty is retained inlibrary but not a validatedmeasurement uncertainty budget.

Four finite mechanisms are loadheadmaintenancecover+Z.160m,loading slide+Y.045m,lowerreleasegate+Y.040m,andlower electrode−Z.100m. Cover travel 0.160 m is an engineering estimate: photo-reconstructed cover top is approximately 0.840 m, exposed rear filter tubes set the 0.915 m nominal overall height, and opened cover reaches the source 1.000 m envelope. The OEM specifies overall heights, not cover stroke. Local travels, speeds and cold threshold are engineering proxies. Fixedupper electrode is not lowered. Routine loading usesloadingfunnel withmaintenancecoverclosed. No20-positionautoloader/autocleaner/realparticletrajectory orrobotpickup is implemented. Crucibleinstalled bool supports separatevisualbinding, not actual roboticinsertion.

Gas/coolantloss andlogicalpowerstop haltongoingfusion andretainconsumption andpartialwindows. Remainingtransport mayflush under continuedcarrier, unreleasedmaterial staysincrucible, anddiscardmovesit todisposedbooks. Only predrop heldsample mayreturn as originalmaterial. Coldunloadingtemperature is explicit numericalthreshold, not OEM electronicinterlockcertification.

All physics andfinite motion advance solely viahoststep; purequery/describe do notconsume oradvance. Atomiccommandrejection restores randomgenerator andstate. Authenticatedper-instance Sessionsupports filteredagent/evaluator views, requestdedup/conflict andownedpoll/cancel. 256records/64curves are engineeringin-memorylimits, not OEMstorage; no cross-processpersistence/OSisolation orhardwareprotocol claim.

Six internalSIM readouts are O/N/H inferredfraction, furnacepowerW, totalrelativesignal andprogress, not originalLCD. Furnaceworkareaillumination has a publicboolmapped tologicalpower as an explicitengineeringlightingconvention. Actualfourjoints/cruciblevisibility/LED/nativeintegration require separate geometryandMatterixreports. Originalelectronics, release-timearrays, driftcalibration, gasdosecalibration,fullGUI, autoloader/autocleaner, hardware/HIL/robot remain not_run.

limitations: ONH836-C analyzer without touch-screen/PC geometry. One inert-gas graphite-crucible fusion measures O/N/H simultaneously. Helium and argon are separate methods, no carrier changeover during a run. 1g is manufacturer nominal sample mass; this implementation restricts gross mass to0–1g as an explicit engineering scope, not a claimed maximumhardwarecapacity.

O absolute range5e-11–5e-5kg; N He5e-11–3e-5kg versusAr2e-10–3e-5kg; H1e-10–2.5e-6kg. OEM lowerlimit is2blankdeviations andprecision1blankdeviation or statedRSD; these aggregate figures are not the synthetic noise sigma. All range checks apply inferredresults, never hidden sample mass content.

Power0–7500W is impulsefurnace electricalpower, not totalinstrumentheat. Source490cc/min referenceT/P and22psi pressurebasis unspecified; host supplies explicit gasreference pressure/temperature for m3/s→mol/s. Source85–130s analysis and180–210scycle dependcarrier/analyte. Numerical shortdurations, thermalcapacity/cooling/conversionrates/gain/noise are declared hostfixtures, not acceleratedproof ofsourceperformance.

Graphite consumes carbon as sampleO becomes CO/CO2; the host fixes CO branchfraction. CuO consumes separate reagentoxygen converting CO→CO2 and H2→H2O andproducesCu. SampleO does not include reagentO. Gaschannels are a linear response convention: co=gO*MO*nCO,co2low=2*gO*MO*nCO2post,co2high=2*gO*MO*nCO2pre; CO/highCO2 are beforeCuO andlowCO2/H2O afterCuO. O response=co2low-co. This uses the combinedCO/CO2 information without counting reagentoxygen as sampleoxygen. Hresponse=gH*2MH*nH2O, Nresponse=gN*2MN*nN2. These are relative surrogate outputs, not OEM IRabsorbance/current electronics or measured gainratio.

Finite analyte/blank release and common transport use a two-compartment linear exact exponential overconstantpower stages. Outgasrate scaleswithP/6000W andfusionratewithP/4800W;0Woutgas causes no blankrelease. These powerproxies are not an Arrhenius/thermalmelting model, even though thermalenergy separately closes. CuOreaction anddownstreamNDIR/scrubbingaftertransport are zeroadditionalresidencetime engineeringapproximations. O/N/H elementalbooks, carboninput/out/disposed, CuOoxygen/copper, capturedCO2/H2O, carrierHe/Ar andDFCsupply are explicit. Unknownmatrix remainsunspecifiedresidue; no oxide/mineralphases orunreportedO/N/H contributions are synthesized.

CO2/H2O sorbent capacities are finite molar-equivalent capacities, not an invented reagentmass. Named source magnesiumperchlorate is Mg(ClO4)2; schematic MgClO4 is not used as a chemicalformula. Sodiumhydroxide supportchemistry/copperturningdetails andreal scrubbing breakthrough kinetics are not solved. DFCadds actual samecarrier moles matching removedCO2/H2O up to explicit hostcapacity; deficit flags invalidanalysis, no OEM feedback dynamics claimed.

Gross weighing and publicdeclared_elements represent hostinputs. Records withunreported values retain null andunknownremainder; declaredunreported channels returnunavailable regardless syntheticbackground. Source drymass requires explicit dryfraction; source minimumaliquot is respected where known. Existing metals/ceramics are source references, not molecularspeciation. Ni fluxbasket andadditionalgraphite orsource matrices are conditiontransfers, not automaticallyinstalledhardware or demonstratedcompletefusion.

Every assay collects actual preanalysisbaseline windows, then dropgate andfusion/tailwindows. Savedmatchingcrucibleblank subtracts actualintegratedbackground. >=3distinctmass observedstandardrecords fitresponsearea versus publicreferenceelementmass using leastsquares. No directtruth-to-result, no arbitraryexternal observations trustedasactualrecords. Calibrations bindcarrier/method/response/library; interpolationonly, endpoint/saturation/reagent/incomplete/negative/rangefail produce null. Certificate/source uncertainty is retained inlibrary but not a validatedmeasurement uncertainty budget.

Four finite mechanisms are loadheadmaintenancecover+Z.160m,loading slide+Y.045m,lowerreleasegate+Y.040m,andlower electrode−Z.100m. Cover travel 0.160 m is an engineering estimate: photo-reconstructed cover top is approximately 0.840 m, exposed rear filter tubes set the 0.915 m nominal overall height, and opened cover reaches the source 1.000 m envelope. The OEM specifies overall heights, not cover stroke. Local travels, speeds and cold threshold are engineering proxies. Fixedupper electrode is not lowered. Routine loading usesloadingfunnel withmaintenancecoverclosed. No20-positionautoloader/autocleaner/realparticletrajectory orrobotpickup is implemented. Crucibleinstalled bool supports separatevisualbinding, not actual roboticinsertion.

Gas/coolantloss andlogicalpowerstop haltongoingfusion andretainconsumption andpartialwindows. Remainingtransport mayflush under continuedcarrier, unreleasedmaterial staysincrucible, anddiscardmovesit todisposedbooks. Only predrop heldsample mayreturn as originalmaterial. Coldunloadingtemperature is explicit numericalthreshold, not OEM electronicinterlockcertification.

All physics andfinite motion advance solely viahoststep; purequery/describe do notconsume oradvance. Atomiccommandrejection restores randomgenerator andstate. Authenticatedper-instance Sessionsupports filteredagent/evaluator views, requestdedup/conflict andownedpoll/cancel. 256records/64curves are engineeringin-memorylimits, not OEMstorage; no cross-processpersistence/OSisolation orhardwareprotocol claim.

Six internalSIM readouts are O/N/H inferredfraction, furnacepowerW, totalrelativesignal andprogress, not originalLCD. Furnaceworkareaillumination has a publicboolmapped tologicalpower as an explicitengineeringlightingconvention. Actualfourjoints/cruciblevisibility/LED/nativeintegration require separate geometryandMatterixreports. Originalelectronics, release-timearrays, driftcalibration, gasdosecalibration,fullGUI, autoloader/autocleaner, hardware/HIL/robot remain not_run.

limitations: ONH836-C analyzer without touch-screen/PC geometry. One inert-gas graphite-crucible fusion measures O/N/H simultaneously. Helium and argon are separate methods, no carrier changeover during a run. 1g is manufacturer nominal sample mass; this implementation restricts gross mass to0–1g as an explicit engineering scope, not a claimed maximumhardwarecapacity.

O absolute range5e-11–5e-5kg; N He5e-11–3e-5kg versusAr2e-10–3e-5kg; H1e-10–2.5e-6kg. OEM lowerlimit is2blankdeviations andprecision1blankdeviation or statedRSD; these aggregate figures are not the synthetic noise sigma. All range checks apply inferredresults, never hidden sample mass content.

Power0–7500W is impulsefurnace electricalpower, not totalinstrumentheat. Source490cc/min referenceT/P and22psi pressurebasis unspecified; host supplies explicit gasreference pressure/temperature for m3/s→mol/s. Source85–130s analysis and180–210scycle dependcarrier/analyte. Numerical shortdurations, thermalcapacity/cooling/conversionrates/gain/noise are declared hostfixtures, not acceleratedproof ofsourceperformance.

Graphite consumes carbon as sampleO becomes CO/CO2; the host fixes CO branchfraction. CuO consumes separate reagentoxygen converting CO→CO2 and H2→H2O andproducesCu. SampleO does not include reagentO. Gaschannels are a linear response convention: co=gO*MO*nCO,co2low=2*gO*MO*nCO2post,co2high=2*gO*MO*nCO2pre; CO/highCO2 are beforeCuO andlowCO2/H2O afterCuO. O response=co2low-co. This uses the combinedCO/CO2 information without counting reagentoxygen as sampleoxygen. Hresponse=gH*2MH*nH2O, Nresponse=gN*2MN*nN2. These are relative surrogate outputs, not OEM IRabsorbance/current electronics or measured gainratio.

Finite analyte/blank release and common transport use a two-compartment linear exact exponential overconstantpower stages. Outgasrate scaleswithP/6000W andfusionratewithP/4800W;0Woutgas causes no blankrelease. These powerproxies are not an Arrhenius/thermalmelting model, even though thermalenergy separately closes. CuOreaction anddownstreamNDIR/scrubbingaftertransport are zeroadditionalresidencetime engineeringapproximations. O/N/H elementalbooks, carboninput/out/disposed, CuOoxygen/copper, capturedCO2/H2O, carrierHe/Ar andDFCsupply are explicit. Unknownmatrix remainsunspecifiedresidue; no oxide/mineralphases orunreportedO/N/H contributions are synthesized.

CO2/H2O sorbent capacities are finite molar-equivalent capacities, not an invented reagentmass. Named source magnesiumperchlorate is Mg(ClO4)2; schematic MgClO4 is not used as a chemicalformula. Sodiumhydroxide supportchemistry/copperturningdetails andreal scrubbing breakthrough kinetics are not solved. DFCadds actual samecarrier moles matching removedCO2/H2O up to explicit hostcapacity; deficit flags invalidanalysis, no OEM feedback dynamics claimed.

Gross weighing and publicdeclared_elements represent hostinputs. Records withunreported values retain null andunknownremainder; declaredunreported channels returnunavailable regardless syntheticbackground. Source drymass requires explicit dryfraction; source minimumaliquot is respected where known. Existing metals/ceramics are source references, not molecularspeciation. Ni fluxbasket andadditionalgraphite orsource matrices are conditiontransfers, not automaticallyinstalledhardware or demonstratedcompletefusion.

Every assay collects actual preanalysisbaseline windows, then dropgate andfusion/tailwindows. Savedmatchingcrucibleblank subtracts actualintegratedbackground. >=3distinctmass observedstandardrecords fitresponsearea versus publicreferenceelementmass using leastsquares. No directtruth-to-result, no arbitraryexternal observations trustedasactualrecords. Calibrations bindcarrier/method/response/library; interpolationonly, endpoint/saturation/reagent/incomplete/negative/rangefail produce null. Certificate/source uncertainty is retained inlibrary but not a validatedmeasurement uncertainty budget.

Four finite mechanisms are loadheadmaintenancecover+Z.160m,loading slide+Y.045m,lowerreleasegate+Y.040m,andlower electrode−Z.100m. Cover travel 0.160 m is an engineering estimate: photo-reconstructed cover top is approximately 0.840 m, exposed rear filter tubes set the 0.915 m nominal overall height, and opened cover reaches the source 1.000 m envelope. The OEM specifies overall heights, not cover stroke. Local travels, speeds and cold threshold are engineering proxies. Fixedupper electrode is not lowered. Routine loading usesloadingfunnel withmaintenancecoverclosed. No20-positionautoloader/autocleaner/realparticletrajectory orrobotpickup is implemented. Crucibleinstalled bool supports separatevisualbinding, not actual roboticinsertion.

Gas/coolantloss andlogicalpowerstop haltongoingfusion andretainconsumption andpartialwindows. Remainingtransport mayflush under continuedcarrier, unreleasedmaterial staysincrucible, anddiscardmovesit todisposedbooks. Only predrop heldsample mayreturn as originalmaterial. Coldunloadingtemperature is explicit numericalthreshold, not OEM electronicinterlockcertification.

All physics andfinite motion advance solely viahoststep; purequery/describe do notconsume oradvance. Atomiccommandrejection restores randomgenerator andstate. Authenticatedper-instance Sessionsupports filteredagent/evaluator views, requestdedup/conflict andownedpoll/cancel. 256records/64curves are engineeringin-memorylimits, not OEMstorage; no cross-processpersistence/OSisolation orhardwareprotocol claim.

Six internalSIM readouts are O/N/H inferredfraction, furnacepowerW, totalrelativesignal andprogress, not originalLCD. Furnaceworkareaillumination has a publicboolmapped tologicalpower as an explicitengineeringlightingconvention. Actualfourjoints/cruciblevisibility/LED/nativeintegration require separate geometryandMatterixreports. status.phase.meaning_zh: status.phase；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；预热状态：off/warming/ready（转换器±10 K、PMT±1 K内为ready）。

status.flags.meaning_zh: status.flags；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；GUI状态标志（预热、超量程、入口压力越界、环境越界、无臭氧、校准中、部分转换按假设）。

range.full_scales_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
range.full_scales_mol_mol.meaning_zh: range.full scales mol mol；设定值，由 range.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；四个满量程。

range.index.meaning_zh: range.index，范围 0–3；设定值，由 range.select 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；当前量程序号。

range.active_full_scale_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
range.active_full_scale_mol_mol.meaning_zh: range.active full scale mol mol，范围 5e-06–0.005 mol/mol；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；当前量程满量程。

filter.time_constant_s.meaning_zh: filter.time constant s，范围 0–60 s；设定值，由 filter.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；输出滤波时间常数。

measurement.phase.meaning_zh: measurement.phase；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；连续测量状态。

measurement.points.meaning_zh: measurement.points，≥0；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；已记录的1 Hz序列点数。

calibration.phase.meaning_zh: calibration.phase；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；校准状态。

calibration.span_no_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
calibration.span_no_mol_mol.meaning_zh: calibration.span no mol mol；设定值，由 calibration.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；NO通道跨度气证书浓度。

calibration.span_nox_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
calibration.span_nox_mol_mol.meaning_zh: calibration.span nox mol mol；设定值，由 calibration.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；NOx通道跨度气证书浓度。

calibration.window_s.meaning_zh: calibration.window s，范围 5–600 s；设定值，由 calibration.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；校准平均窗口。

calibration.zero_offset_no_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
calibration.zero_offset_no_mol_mol.meaning_zh: calibration.zero offset no mol mol；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；NO通道零点偏置（归一化信号单位）。

calibration.zero_offset_nox_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
calibration.zero_offset_nox_mol_mol.meaning_zh: calibration.zero offset nox mol mol；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；NOx通道零点偏置。

calibration.gain_no.meaning_zh: calibration.gain no，≥0；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；NO通道增益（出厂1.0）。

calibration.gain_nox.meaning_zh: calibration.gain nox，≥0；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；NOx通道增益（出厂1.0）。

inlet.source.meaning_zh: inlet.source；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；入口接的是什么：ambient_air / standard:<id> / sample（宿主样品，标签只对evaluator可见）。

inlet.indicated_pressure_pa.reference_conditions: 绝压（厂家进口600–1200 mbar abs.）。
inlet.indicated_pressure_pa.meaning_zh: inlet.indicated pressure pa，≥0 Pa；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；入口绝压显示（一阶0.5 s，1 Pa分辨率）。

flow.indicated_sample_m3_s.reference_conditions: 气体体积流量，按101325 Pa、298.15 K参考状态（假设；厂家1.0 l/min未注明参考状态）；临界限流下与入口绝压成正比。
flow.indicated_sample_m3_s.meaning_zh: flow.indicated sample m3 s，≥0 m^3/s；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；样气体积流量显示。

display.no_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
display.no_mol_mol.meaning_zh: display.no mol mol；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；屏幕NO读数（0.1 ppm分辨率；关机为null）。

display.no2_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
display.no2_mol_mol.meaning_zh: display.no2 mol mol；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；屏幕NO2读数=NOx−NO。

display.nox_mol_mol.reference_conditions: 摩尔分数（湿基：样气按到达状态，不干燥；1 ppm = 1e-6 mol/mol），与温压无关。
display.nox_mol_mol.meaning_zh: display.nox mol mol；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；屏幕NOx读数。

cartridge_cover.angle_rad.meaning_zh: 该部件cartridge cover.angle rad，范围 0–1.4 rad；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings；卡盒盖（内门）开启角，0=关闭。

insertion_bar.angle_rad.reference_conditions: 资产坐标系（+X 右、+Y 向后、+Z 上，原点台面投影中心）；关节零位为闭合/初始位，正向沿 URDF 关节轴。
insertion_bar.angle_rad.meaning_zh: 该部件insertion bar.angle rad，范围 0–1 rad；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings；插入杆抬起角，0=压下夹紧卡盒。

cartridge.installed.meaning_zh: cartridge.installed；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；接口块上是否装有毛细管卡盒。

cartridge.inner_diameter_m.meaning_zh: cartridge.inner diameter m；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；毛细管内径（未装卡盒为null）。

cartridge.length_to_detector_m.meaning_zh: cartridge.length to detector m；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；进样端到检测窗的有效长度。

cartridge.total_length_m.meaning_zh: cartridge.total length m；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；毛细管总长=有效长度+10.2 cm（维护手册表1-3）。

cartridge.coating.meaning_zh: cartridge.coating；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；内壁：裸熔融石英（有电渗流）或中性/N-CHO涂层（电渗流被抑制）。

capillary.target_k.meaning_zh: capillary.target k，范围 288.15–333.15 K；设定值，由 capillary.set_temperature 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；毛细管冷却液温度目标。

capillary.temperature_k.meaning_zh: capillary.temperature k，≥0 K；传感器读数代理，含一阶响应与分辨率量化，未按厂家精度标定；冷却液温度读数（0.1 K量化）。

sample_storage.target_k.meaning_zh: sample storage.target k，范围 277.15–333.15 K；设定值，由 sample_storage.set_temperature 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；样品托盘温控目标。

sample_storage.temperature_k.meaning_zh: sample storage.temperature k，≥0 K；传感器读数代理，含一阶响应与分辨率量化，未按厂家精度标定；样品托盘温度读数（0.1 K量化）。

lamp.on.meaning_zh: lamp.on；设定值，由 lamp.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；氘灯开关设定。

lamp.ready.meaning_zh: lamp.ready；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；氘灯已点亮且暖机时间达到（工程阈值300 s）。

detector.module.meaning_zh: detector.module；设定值，由 detector.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；检测模块：滤光片紫外或二极管阵列。

detector.mode.meaning_zh: detector.mode；设定值，由 detector.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；直接紫外或间接紫外检测。

detector.wavelength_m.meaning_zh: detector.wavelength m，范围 1.9e-07–6e-07 m；设定值，由 detector.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；检测波长。

detector.data_rate_hz.meaning_zh: detector.data rate hz，范围 0.5–32 Hz；设定值，由 detector.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；数据采集频率。

method.configured.meaning_zh: 运行方法是否已配置；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

method.step_count.meaning_zh: method.step count，范围 0–20；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；方法程序步数。

cycle.phase.meaning_zh: 运行阶段：idle/running/succeeded/cancelled（failed）；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

cycle.stage.meaning_zh: 运行中的子阶段名称，由过程状态机推进；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；当前方法步类型。

cycle.step_index.meaning_zh: cycle.step index，范围 -1–20；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；当前方法步序号（未运行为-1）。

cycle.elapsed_s.meaning_zh: 本次运行自 acquisition.start 起的仿真时间，≥0 s；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

cycle.fault.meaning_zh: 最近一次故障或拒绝的原因文字，空串表示无；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；最近一次中止/故障原因（DOOR_INTERLOCK、CURRENT_FAULT、CAPILLARY_DRY、VIAL_OVERFLOW、VIAL_EMPTY、VIAL_MISSING、POWER_LOSS、LAMP_OFF、USER_STOP），空串为无。

hv.voltage_v.meaning_zh: hv.voltage v，范围 -30000–30000 V；传感器读数代理，含一阶响应与分辨率量化，未按厂家精度标定；实际施加的分离电压读数（带极性，正=进样端为正极）。

hv.current_a.meaning_zh: hv.current a，≥0 A；传感器读数代理，含一阶响应与分辨率量化，未按厂家精度标定；分离电流读数（0.1 µA量化）。

pressure.applied_pa.meaning_zh: pressure.applied pa，范围 -34473.8–689476 Pa；传感器读数代理，含一阶响应与分辨率量化，未按厂家精度标定；当前施加的压力（表压，正=由进样端推向出口端）。

led.power.meaning_zh: led.power；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；面板PWR指示灯。

led.uv.meaning_zh: led.uv；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；面板UV指示灯（氘灯点亮）。

led.hv_positive.meaning_zh: led.hv positive；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；面板HV+指示灯（正极性高压施加中）。

led.hv_negative.meaning_zh: led.hv negative；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；面板HV−指示灯（反极性高压施加中）。

trays.vials.meaning_zh: trays.vials；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；各托盘位上的样品瓶标签与液体体积（肉眼可见量，不含组成）。

result.available.meaning_zh: result.available；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；是否已有可读取的电泳图。

power.control.meaning_zh: power.control；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；control模块电源开关状态。

status.control.meaning_zh: status.control；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；control模块状态指示灯代理（off/not_ready黄/ready绿/run/error红）。

power.pump.meaning_zh: power.pump；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；pump模块电源开关状态。

status.pump.meaning_zh: status.pump；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；pump模块状态指示灯代理（off/not_ready黄/ready绿/run/error红）。

power.sampler.meaning_zh: power.sampler；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；sampler模块电源开关状态。

status.sampler.meaning_zh: status.sampler；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；sampler模块状态指示灯代理（off/not_ready黄/ready绿/run/error红）。

power.mct.meaning_zh: power.mct；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；mct模块电源开关状态。

status.mct.meaning_zh: status.mct；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；mct模块状态指示灯代理（off/not_ready黄/ready绿/run/error红）。

power.dad.meaning_zh: power.dad；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程；dad模块电源开关状态。

status.dad.meaning_zh: status.dad；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；dad模块状态指示灯代理（off/not_ready黄/ready绿/run/error红）。

supply.connected.meaning_zh: supply.connected；场景状态，由宿主登记，不由过程模型推导；CO2气瓶是否接到控制模块进口。

supply.pressure_pa.reference_conditions: 表压；CO2供气相对环境大气压。厂家40–70 bar（580–1000 psi）按表压解释，这是本资产的假设。
supply.pressure_pa.meaning_zh: supply.pressure pa，≥0 Pa；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；CO2供气表压（气瓶空时为0）。

co2.ready.meaning_zh: co2.ready；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；供气压力在40–70 bar且冷却器≤9 °C时CO2调理就绪。

method.configured.meaning_zh: 运行方法是否已配置；设定值，由 method.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

pump.enabled.meaning_zh: pump.enabled；设定值，由 pump.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

pump.flow_target_m3_s.reference_conditions: 泵头条件下的总体积流量（CO2+改性剂），与厂家mL/min设定一致；未作可压缩性换算。
pump.flow_target_m3_s.meaning_zh: pump.flow target m3 s；设定值，由 method.configure 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

pump.flow_m3_s.reference_conditions: 泵头条件下的总体积流量（CO2+改性剂）；色谱模型按柱内体积流量近似使用。
pump.flow_m3_s.meaning_zh: pump.flow m3 s，≥0 m^3/s；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；泵实际总体积流量（泵头条件，未作压缩性换算）。

pump.modifier_fraction.meaning_zh: pump.modifier fraction，范围 0–1；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；泵出口改性剂体积分数（梯度表当前值）。

pump.indicated_pressure_pa.reference_conditions: 表压；相对环境大气压。厂家600 bar上限按表压解释。
pump.indicated_pressure_pa.meaning_zh: pump.indicated pressure pa，≥0 Pa；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度；泵压力显示（0.1 bar量化）。

model_effects.description_zh: 几何联动由独立场景验证；压入为刚性姿态代理，没有真实网格凹坑/接触求解

execution.completion_criterion: 命令不推进时钟；电动目标等待宿主step，Y明确手动定位
execution.partial_failure_zh: 永久保留已压入点与塑性耗散；取消保留实际载荷，随后hoststep按显式弹簧释放；未完成点不计完整结果

limitations: 标称20nN/10pm分辨率不等于准确度/噪声验证

model_effects.description_zh: 五关节（四独立运动状态）与双数值屏由场景独立验证；Matterix参考试片网格不形变

execution.completion_criterion: 命令接受后有限运动与热/应力过程等待宿主step
execution.partial_failure_zh: 取消/断气/软件停机保留实际应变、Maxwell支路应力、弹性能与余热；终态观测不可变，不自动复原。

limitations: 仅线性单轴拉伸film/fiber，其他夹具无默认支持
实测锚只在原频率和来源允许温区内插值，单点SLS谱依赖显式tau，并非由单点辨识材料谱
source_curve按每个区块自身(T,f)用同一真实记录重新锚定，区块之间保持上一锚点，固定应变下弹性能变化单独记入constitutive_update_j
悬臂/三点弯/压缩来源只在显式accept_condition_transfer下作为小应变各向同性E*转用于拉伸，剪切G*与未知频率记录仍仅参考
力幅值模式是谐波位移前馈，实际力跟踪误差另报，不冒称原机伺服
内部观测谐波拟合含显式传感器增益、零点、相位延迟，未制造噪声分布/厂家accuracy
NPC冷量/气量有限；炉/试片两节点工程热模型不是原机热校准；no cooler不能主动冷到ambient以下

model_effects.description_zh: 五关节（四独立运动状态）与双数值屏由场景独立验证；Matterix参考试片网格不形变

execution.completion_criterion: 命令接受后有限运动与热/应力过程等待宿主step
execution.partial_failure_zh: 取消/断气/软件停机保留实际应变、Maxwell支路应力、弹性能与余热；终态观测不可变，不自动复原。

limitations: 仅线性单轴拉伸film/fiber，其他夹具无默认支持
实测锚只在原频率和来源允许温区内插值，单点SLS谱依赖显式tau，并非由单点辨识材料谱
source_curve按每个区块自身(T,f)用同一真实记录重新锚定，区块之间保持上一锚点，固定应变下弹性能变化单独记入constitutive_update_j
悬臂/三点弯/压缩来源只在显式accept_condition_transfer下作为小应变各向同性E*转用于拉伸，剪切G*与未知频率记录仍仅参考
力幅值模式是谐波位移前馈，实际力跟踪误差另报，不冒称原机伺服
内部观测谐波拟合含显式传感器增益、零点、相位延迟，未制造噪声分布/厂家accuracy
NPC冷量/气量有限；炉/试片两节点工程热模型不是原机热校准；no cooler不能主动冷到ambient以下

preconditions.description_zh: 冷态开炉/无载夹紧、有限airbearing与N2、正拉伸预载、源T/f域或显式工程谱，原子拒绝
preconditions.check: atomic invocation and mechanical, thermal, source-domain guards

execution.partial_failure_zh: 取消/断气/软件停机保留实际应变、Maxwell支路应力、弹性能与余热；终态观测不可变，不自动复原。

limitations: 仅线性单轴拉伸film/fiber，其他夹具无默认支持
实测锚只在原频率和来源允许温区内插值，单点SLS谱依赖显式tau，并非由单点辨识材料谱
source_curve按每个区块自身(T,f)用同一真实记录重新锚定，区块之间保持上一锚点，固定应变下弹性能变化单独记入constitutive_update_j
悬臂/三点弯/压缩来源只在显式accept_condition_transfer下作为小应变各向同性E*转用于拉伸，剪切G*与未知频率记录仍仅参考

内部观测谐波拟合含显式传感器增益、零点、相位延迟，未制造噪声分布/厂家accuracy
NPC冷量/气量有限；炉/试片两节点工程热模型不是原机热校准；no cooler不能主动冷到ambient以下

execution.completion_criterion: 命令原子接受；运动/热/载荷响应等待宿主step
execution.partial_failure_zh: 取消保留实际载荷、可恢复压缩和余热。模型出域停止本构更新并保留最后有效力/长度，继续被动热交换；重载样品后才可重新测量。

limitations: 仅标准450温度/force ramp的固体膨胀；EM creep/relaxation/dynamic/modulated以及isostrain当前未实现
内部Kelvin材料压缩记忆是显式工程假设，不是宣称标准450拥有EM功能
PTFE原机为450EM标准膨胀模式，保留跨型号/载荷/速率工程迁移；铜是NIST干涉仪参考表
CTE仅外部观察减blank回归，不从隐藏alpha返回结果；软化仅所选窗口交点
原厂heater功率未知，1200W为供电而非热端实测；LN2有效潜热与换热系数显式输入
双气源库存守恒；未求解腔气氛置换、purge显热与真实温度梯度

execution.completion_criterion: 命令原子接受；运动/热/载荷响应等待宿主step
execution.partial_failure_zh: 取消保留实际载荷、可恢复压缩和余热。模型出域停止本构更新并保留最后有效力/长度，继续被动热交换；重载样品后才可重新测量。

limitations: 仅标准450温度/force ramp的固体膨胀；EM creep/relaxation/dynamic/modulated以及isostrain当前未实现
内部Kelvin材料压缩记忆是显式工程假设，不是宣称标准450拥有EM功能
PTFE原机为450EM标准膨胀模式，保留跨型号/载荷/速率工程迁移；铜是NIST干涉仪参考表
CTE仅外部观察减blank回归，不从隐藏alpha返回结果；软化仅所选窗口交点
原厂heater功率未知，1200W为供电而非热端实测；LN2有效潜热与换热系数显式输入
双气源库存守恒；未求解腔气氛置换、purge显热与真实温度梯度

model_effects.description_zh: 四关节与六状态灯由独立场景验证；无数值机身显示

execution.completion_criterion: 原子命令接受；有限运动/热响应等待宿主step
execution.partial_failure_zh: 取消/故障冻结已采集IR及脉冲观测，保留空间温度场、已排气/蒸发LN2与未发射能量；不回滚物理状态。

limitations: Only ordinary LFA467, not HT. One homogeneous opaque isotropic disk in sixteen-position12.7mm holder; no automatic batch or dynamic pan reparenting.
Finite rectangular pulse is an explicitly accepted waveform; no measured OEM pulse mapping, proprietary Cowan/Cape-Lehman algorithm, or hardware accuracy/noise certification.

Alpha interpolated only inside the real reference domain (single-temperature references: explicit record-declared constant-alpha band), sampled at equilibrated baseline and held fixed during small temperature-rise shot. Library alpha is measured/evaluated for 15 materials and derived alpha=k/(rho*cp) for 45; the record evidence level is appended to every acquisition evidence string. Unknown density/Cp/absorptance/face losses and detector response are engineering inputs.

Finite gas exhaust is tracked per three branches; chamber mixing, pressure/vacuum and gas enthalpy not solved. Detector cooling is ideal regulated cold-front-end supplied by finite explicit LN2 budget; no empirical cooldown model.
Only none/LN2 furnace cooling implemented. Independent detector and furnace LN2 inventories; no artificial clipping to ambient. No comparative heat-capacity calibration.

SamplerXY/head paths are engineering geometry proxies, not a reconstruction of proprietary mechanics. Static scene specimen represents slot1; alternate loaded slots and dimensions lack dynamic geometry replacement.

execution.completion_criterion: 原子命令接受；有限运动/热响应等待宿主step
execution.partial_failure_zh: 取消/故障冻结已采集IR及脉冲观测，保留空间温度场、已排气/蒸发LN2与未发射能量；不回滚物理状态。

limitations: Only ordinary LFA467, not HT. One homogeneous opaque isotropic disk in sixteen-position12.7mm holder; no automatic batch or dynamic pan reparenting.
Finite rectangular pulse is an explicitly accepted waveform; no measured OEM pulse mapping, proprietary Cowan/Cape-Lehman algorithm, or hardware accuracy/noise certification.

Alpha interpolated only inside the real reference domain (single-temperature references: explicit record-declared constant-alpha band), sampled at equilibrated baseline and held fixed during small temperature-rise shot. Library alpha is measured/evaluated for 15 materials and derived alpha=k/(rho*cp) for 45; the record evidence level is appended to every acquisition evidence string. Unknown density/Cp/absorptance/face losses and detector response are engineering inputs.

Finite gas exhaust is tracked per three branches; chamber mixing, pressure/vacuum and gas enthalpy not solved. Detector cooling is ideal regulated cold-front-end supplied by finite explicit LN2 budget; no empirical cooldown model.
Only none/LN2 furnace cooling implemented. Independent detector and furnace LN2 inventories; no artificial clipping to ambient. No comparative heat-capacity calibration.

SamplerXY/head paths are engineering geometry proxies, not a reconstruction of proprietary mechanics. Static scene specimen represents slot1; alternate loaded slots and dimensions lack dynamic geometry replacement.
